1	/-
2	  TRAINING SPLIT variant, generated by harness/tools/split.py from the full file: the lines that read the
3	  atoms the split omits are removed. Do not edit; regenerate.
4	-/
5	/-
6	  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Semantics
7	  The meaning of a formula over a trace: one three-valued result with reasons per instant.
8	
9	  `evalAll` evaluates a formula bottom-up, each subformula once for the whole trace, so a formula
10	  costs O(|φ| · n log n) per binding: atoms map a scene function over the instants, the temporal
11	  operators are the single-pass operators of Temporal.lean, quantifiers evaluate their body once
12	  per region or device present anywhere in the trace. `eval c i φ` is the value at instant i.
13	
14	  Atoms and derived concepts are dispatched by name to the definitions of Atoms.lean and
15	  Primitives.lean; a name the tables do not know, a wrong arity, a literal that spells no
16	  enumeration value or a variable of the wrong sort is `unknown (malformed …)`. The static check
17	  (RuleEval.check) finds every such defect from the syntax before any trace is read, so a checked
18	  rule reports at evaluation time only source absence, truncation, sampling gaps, undefined
19	  concept preconditions, division by zero and unknown compositions.
20	
21	  Finite-trace policy — unobserved is unknown, never compliance:
22	  - `holdsFor` needs its whole window observed at adequate density, else unknown;
23	  - `within`/`untilWithin` are true on a witness, false only when the window is covered;
24	  - `eventually`/`until` carry the unobserved future, `since` the unobserved past, and `always`
25	    the unobserved future as unknown: on a finite trace `always φ` is false or unknown, never true.
26	    A rule's obligation is written for an instant; the sweep over instants (Grounding) is the
27	    "always".
28	
29	  Rule composition is a callback, because the library of rules is defined above this file.
30	-/
31	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula

35	namespace TrafficSpec
36	namespace Semantics

38	open Primitives (DArg)

41	/-- Everything an evaluation needs: the indexed trace with its reading, the bindings, and how to
42	    evaluate another rule's obligation (`rule id map`) under a variable map, per instant. -/
43	structure SemCtx where
44	  d : Primitives.Ctx
45	  β : Binding := {}
46	  /-- Another rule's verdict per instant under a variable map: complied-with when `engaged` is
47	      false, engaged (classes and applicability) when true. -/
48	  compose : String → List (String × String) → Binding → Bool → Array R :=
49	    fun _ _ _ _ => #[]
50	
51	namespace SemCtx
52	def n (c : SemCtx) : Nat := c.d.n
53	def scenes (c : SemCtx) : Array Scene := c.d.scenes
54	def bindVar (c : SemCtx) (v : String) (x : Val) : SemCtx := { c with β := c.β.bind v x }
55	def mk' (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) (β : Binding := {}) : SemCtx := { d := Primitives.Ctx.mk' τ ρ, β := β }
56	end SemCtx

58	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
59	-- Arguments
60	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
61	def resolve (β : Binding) : Arg → Except UnknownReason DArg
62	  | .var v =>
63	    match β.lookup v with
64	    | some (.track t) => .ok (.v t)
65	    | some (.region r) => .ok (.v r)
66	    | some (.device d) => .ok (.v d)
67	    | none => .error (.unboundVariable v)
68	  | .lit s => .ok (.s s)
69	  | .nat k => .ok (.n k)
70	
71	def resolveAll (β : Binding) (args : List Arg) : Except UnknownReason (List DArg) := args.mapM (resolve β)
72	
73	private def ent (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason Nat :=
74	  match a with | .v t => .ok t | .n k => .ok k | .s _ => .error (.malformed "entity expected")
75	private def lit (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason String :=
76	  match a with | .s s => .ok s | _ => .error (.malformed "literal expected")
77	private def enumLit {α : Type} (ofString : String → Option α) (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason α := do
78	  let s ← lit a
79	  match ofString s with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.malformed s)
80	
81	private def b (o : Option Bool) (name : String) : R := R.ofOption o (.absentAtom name)
82	private def eqEnum {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (o : Option α) (v : α) (name : String) : R :=
83	  b (o.map (· == v)) name
84	private def q (o : Option Q) (name : String) : QR :=
85	  match o with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
86	private def qn (o : Option Nat) (name : String) : QR :=
87	  match o with | some v => .ok (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat v)) | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
88	private def qz (o : Option Int) (name : String) : QR :=
89	  match o with | some v => .ok (Q.ofInt v) | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
90	
91	def unknownAtom (n : String) : UnknownReason := .malformed s!"atom {n}"
92	def arity (n : String) : UnknownReason := .malformed s!"arity {n}"
93	
94	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
95	-- Boolean atoms by name, on one scene. Class atoms (`ru_*`, `st_*`, `dev_*` kinds) are dispatched
96	-- through the generated codecs, so the table cannot drift from ATOMS.md; attribute atoms are listed.
97	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
98	def evalAtomE (s : Scene) (name : String) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) : Except UnknownReason R := do
99	  match name, args with
100	  -- road users
101	  | "ru_subject", [x] => pure (b (ru_subject s (← ent x)) name)
102	  | "ru_aggregate", [_, .s w] => .error (.parameterMissing s!"aggregate:{w}")   -- resolved with the reading in `evalAll`
103	  | "ru_rider_posture", [x, f] =>
104	    match f with
105	    | .s "on_seat" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_on_seat s (← ent x)) name)
106	    | .s "standing_on_deck" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_standing_on_deck s (← ent x)) name)
107	    | .s "holding_another_vehicle" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_holding_another_vehicle s (← ent x)) name)
108	    | .s "stunt" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_stunt s (← ent x)) name)
109	    | _ => .error (.malformed "posture field")
110	  | "ru_rider_posture_on_seat", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_on_seat s (← ent x)) name)
111	  | "ru_rider_posture_standing_on_deck", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_standing_on_deck s (← ent x)) name)
112	  | "ru_rider_posture_holding_another_vehicle", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_holding_another_vehicle s (← ent x)) name)
113	  | "ru_rider_posture_stunt", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_stunt s (← ent x)) name)
114	  | "ru_emergency_vehicle_kind", [x, k] => pure (eqEnum (ru_emergency_vehicle_kind s (← ent x)) (← enumLit EmergencyKind.ofString k) name)
115	  | "ru_official_vehicle_kind", [x, k] => pure (eqEnum (ru_official_vehicle_kind s (← ent x)) (← enumLit OfficialKind.ofString k) name)
116	  -- control state
117	  | "kin_engine_running", [x] => pure (b (kin_engine_running s (← ent x)) name)
118	  | "kin_parking_brake", [x] => pure (b (kin_parking_brake s (← ent x)) name)
119	  -- structure attributes
120	  | "st_road_edge_paved", [r] => pure (b (st_road_edge_paved s (← ent r)) name)
121	  | "st_shoulder_paved", [r] => pure (b (st_shoulder_paved s (← ent r)) name)
122	  | "st_median_or_divider_opening", [r] => pure (b (st_median_or_divider_opening s (← ent r)) name)
123	  | "st_crosswalk_marked", [r] => pure (b (st_crosswalk_marked s (← ent r)) name)
124	  | "st_reserved_lane_class", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_reserved_lane_class s (← ent r)) (← enumLit ReservedClass.ofString k) name)
125	  | "st_turn_lane_side", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_turn_lane_side s (← ent r)) (← enumLit TurnSide.ofString k) name)
126	  | "st_parking_space_designation", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_parking_space_designation s (← ent r)) (← enumLit ParkingDesignation.ofString k) name)
127	  | "st_curb_zone_kind", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_curb_zone_kind s (← ent r)) (← enumLit CurbZoneKind.ofString k) name)

129	  | "st_obstruction_kind", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_obstruction_kind s (← ent r)) (← enumLit ObstructionKind.ofString k) name)
130	  | "st_lane_adjacency", [r, sd, r'] =>
131	    match sd with
132	    | .s "left" => pure (b (st_lane_left_of s (← ent r) (← ent r')) name)
133	    | .s "right" => pure (b (st_lane_right_of s (← ent r) (← ent r')) name)
134	    | _ => .error (.malformed "side")
135	  | "st_lane_adjacency_left", [r, r'] => pure (b (st_lane_left_of s (← ent r) (← ent r')) name)
136	  | "st_lane_adjacency_right", [r, r'] => pure (b (st_lane_right_of s (← ent r) (← ent r')) name)
137	  | "st_lane_connectivity", [r, r'] => pure (b ((st_lane_connectivity s (← ent r)).map (·.contains (← ent r'))) name)
138	  | "st_lane_enters", [r, i] => pure (b ((st_lane_enters s (← ent r)).map (· == (← ent i))) name)
139	  | "st_on_way", [r, w] => pure (b ((st_on_way s (← ent r)).map (·.contains (← ent w))) name)
140	  | "st_entrance_of", [l, a] => pure (b (st_entrance_of s (← ent l) (← ent a)) name)
141	  | "st_lane_marking", [r, sd, t] =>
142	    match sd with
143	    | .s "left" => pure (eqEnum ((st_lane_marking_left s (← ent r)).map (·.1)) (← enumLit MarkingType.ofString t) name)
144	    | .s "right" => pure (eqEnum ((st_lane_marking_right s (← ent r)).map (·.1)) (← enumLit MarkingType.ofString t) name)
145	    | _ => .error (.malformed "side")
146	  | "st_lane_marking", [r, sd, t, col] =>
147	    let m ← match sd with
148	      | .s "left" => pure (st_lane_marking_left s (← ent r))
149	      | .s "right" => pure (st_lane_marking_right s (← ent r))
150	      | _ => .error (.malformed "side")
151	    pure (R.and (eqEnum (m.map (·.1)) (← enumLit MarkingType.ofString t) name)
152	                (eqEnum (m.map (·.2)) (← enumLit MarkingColour.ofString col) name))
153	  | "st_lane_marking_left", [r, t] => pure (eqEnum ((st_lane_marking_left s (← ent r)).map (·.1)) (← enumLit MarkingType.ofString t) name)
154	  | "st_lane_marking_right", [r, t] => pure (eqEnum ((st_lane_marking_right s (← ent r)).map (·.1)) (← enumLit MarkingType.ofString t) name)
155	  | "rel_occupies", [x, r] => pure (b (rel_occupies s (← ent x) (← ent r)) name)
156	  -- devices
157	  | "dev_traffic_signal_shows", [d, k] => pure (b (dev_traffic_signal_shows s (← ent d) (← enumLit SignalIndication.ofString k)) name)
158	  | "dev_traffic_signal_uncovered", [d] => pure (b (dev_traffic_signal_uncovered s (← ent d)) name)
159	  | "dev_pedestrian_signal_state", [d, k] => pure (eqEnum (dev_pedestrian_signal_state s (← ent d)) (← enumLit PedSignalState.ofString k) name)
160	  | "dev_pedestrian_signal_countdown", [d] => pure (b (dev_pedestrian_signal_countdown s (← ent d)) name)
161	  | "dev_lane_control_signal_state", [d, k] => pure (eqEnum (dev_lane_control_signal_state s (← ent d)) (← enumLit LaneControlState.ofString k) name)
162	  | "dev_speed_limit_beacon_flashing", [d] => pure (b (dev_speed_limit_beacon_flashing s (← ent d)) name)
163	  | "dev_crossing_warning_signal_active", [d] => pure (b (dev_crossing_warning_signal_active s (← ent d)) name)
164	  | "dev_speed_limit_sign_kind", [d, k] => pure (eqEnum (dev_speed_limit_sign_kind s (← ent d)) (← enumLit SpeedSignKind.ofString k) name)
165	  | "dev_regulatory_sign_code", [d, k] => pure (eqEnum (dev_regulatory_sign_code s (← ent d)) (← enumLit SignCode.ofString k) name)
166	  | "dev_zone_sign_kind", [d, k] => pure (eqEnum (dev_zone_sign_kind s (← ent d)) (← enumLit ZoneKind.ofString k) name)
167	  | "dev_zone_sign_end", [d] => pure (b (dev_zone_sign_end s (← ent d)) name)
168	  | "dev_railway_signal_or_gate_lights", [d, k] => pure (eqEnum (dev_railway_signal_or_gate_lights s (← ent d)) (← enumLit RailLights.ofString k) name)
169	  | "dev_railway_signal_or_gate_gate", [d, k] => pure (eqEnum (dev_railway_signal_or_gate_gate s (← ent d)) (← enumLit GateState.ofString k) name)
170	  | "dev_railway_signal_or_gate_bell", [d] => pure (b (dev_railway_signal_or_gate_bell s (← ent d)) name)
171	  | "dev_human_direction_role", [d, k] => pure (eqEnum (dev_human_direction_role s (← ent d)) (← enumLit HumanRole.ofString k) name)
172	  | "dev_human_direction_indication", [d, k] => pure (eqEnum (dev_human_direction_indication s (← ent d)) (← enumLit HumanIndication.ofString k) name)
173	  | "dev_governs", [d, r] => pure (b (dev_governs s (← ent d) (← ent r)) name)
174	  | "dev_inoperative", [d] => pure (b (dev_inoperative s (← ent d)) name)
175	  -- signals emitted
176	  | "sig_turn_indicator", [x, k] => pure (eqEnum (sig_turn_indicator s (← ent x)) (← enumLit TurnIndicatorState.ofString k) name)
177	  | "sig_brake_lamp", [x] => pure (b (sig_brake_lamp s (← ent x)) name)
178	  | "sig_hazard", [x] => pure (b (sig_hazard s (← ent x)) name)

182	  | "sig_warning_lamp", [x, col, m] => pure (b (sig_warning_lamp_shows s (← ent x) (← enumLit LampColour.ofString col) (← enumLit LampMode.ofString m)) name)
183	  | "sig_siren", [x] => pure (b (sig_siren s (← ent x)) name)
184	  | "sig_horn", [x] => pure (b (sig_horn s (← ent x)) name)
185	  | "sig_hand_signal", [x, k] => pure (eqEnum (sig_hand_signal s (← ent x)) (← enumLit HandSignal.ofString k) name)
186	  | "sig_door_open", [x] => pure (b ((sig_door_open s (← ent x)).map (!·.isEmpty)) name)
187	  | "sig_door_open", [x, k] => pure (b (sig_door_open_side s (← ent x) (← enumLit DoorSide.ofString k)) name)
188	  | "sig_compression_brake", [x] => pure (b (sig_compression_brake s (← ent x)) name)
189	  -- environment
190	  | "env_darkness", [] => pure (b (env_darkness s) name)
191	  | "env_precipitation", [] => pure (b (env_precipitation s) name)
192	  | "env_wet_road", [] => pure (b (env_wet_road s) name)
193	  | "env_ice_or_snow", [] => pure (b (env_ice_or_snow s) name)
194	  -- relations
195	  | "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane", [a, a'] => pure (b (rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name)
196	  | "rel_ahead_in_lane", [a, a'] => pure (b (rel_ahead_in_lane s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name)
197	  | "rel_behind_in_lane", [a, a'] => pure (b (rel_behind_in_lane s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name)
198	  | "rel_oncoming", [a, a'] =>
199	    match ps with
200	    | [tol] => pure (b (rel_oncoming s (← ent a) (← ent a') tol) name)
201	    | _ => .error (.parameterMissing "rel_oncoming cosine tolerance")
202	  | "rel_same_direction", [a, a'] =>
203	    match ps with
204	    | [tol] => pure (b (rel_same_direction s (← ent a) (← ent a') tol) name)
205	    | _ => .error (.parameterMissing "rel_same_direction cosine tolerance")
206	  | "rel_bearing", [a, a', k] =>
207	    match k with
208	    | .s "ahead" => pure (b (rel_bearing_ahead s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name)
209	    | .s "behind" => pure (b (rel_bearing_behind s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name)
210	    | .s "left" => pure (b (rel_bearing_left s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name)
211	    | .s "right" => pure (b (rel_bearing_right s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name)
212	    | _ => .error (.malformed "bearing side")
213	  | "rel_contact", [a, a'] => pure (b (rel_contact s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name)
214	  | "rel_visible", [a, a'] => pure (b (rel_visible s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name)
215	  -- class atoms through the generated codecs
216	  | n, [x] =>
217	    if n.startsWith "ru_" then

221	      | none => .error (unknownAtom n)

225	      | none => .error (unknownAtom n)
226	    else if n.startsWith "dev_" then

229	      | none => .error (unknownAtom n)
230	    else .error (unknownAtom n)
231	  | n, _ =>

233	    else if n.startsWith "st_" && (StructureKind.ofString (n.drop 3).toString).isSome then .error (arity n)
234	    else if n.startsWith "dev_" && (DeviceKind.ofString (n.drop 4).toString).isSome then .error (arity n)
235	    else if boolAtomNames.contains n then .error (arity n)
236	    else .error (unknownAtom n)

259	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
260	-- Measured atoms by name (quantity-valued), on one scene. Vector atoms take a component literal.
261	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
262	private def comp (v : Option Vec) (k : DArg) (name : String) : QR := do
263	  match k with
264	  | .s "x" => q (v.map (·.1)) name
265	  | .s "y" => q (v.map (·.2)) name
266	  | _ => .error (.malformed "component")
267	
268	def evalMeasure (s : Scene) (name : String) (args : List DArg) : QR := do
269	  match name, args with
270	  | "kin_time", [] => .ok (Time.ofTimestamp (kin_time s))
271	  | "kin_position", [x, k] => comp (kin_position s (← ent x)) k name
272	  | "kin_heading", [x, k] => comp ((kin_heading s (← ent x)).bind Geom.unit) k name
273	  | "kin_velocity", [x, k] => comp (kin_velocity s (← ent x)) k name
274	  | "kin_speed", [x] => q (kin_speed s (← ent x)) name
275	  | "kin_accel_longitudinal", [x] => q (kin_accel_longitudinal s (← ent x)) name
276	  | "kin_yaw_rate", [x] => q (kin_yaw_rate s (← ent x)) name
277	  | "kin_extent", [x, k] =>
278	    let e := kin_extent s (← ent x)
279	    match k with   -- full extents: twice the half-extent
280	    | .s "length" => q (e.map fun (l, _, _) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) l) name
281	    | .s "width" => q (e.map fun (_, w, _) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) w) name
282	    | .s "height" => q (e.map fun (_, _, h) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) h) name
283	    | _ => .error (.malformed "extent")
284	  | "kin_steer_angle", [x] => q (kin_steer_angle s (← ent x)) name
285	  | "kin_path_length", [x] => q (kin_path_length s (← ent x)) name
286	  | "kin_gear", [x] => qz (kin_gear s (← ent x)) name

340	/-- Whether a name is known to either table (the doctor holds this against `atomIds`). -/
341	def knowsAtom (n : String) : Bool :=
342	  let s : Scene := { t := 0 }
343	  let isUnknown : Except UnknownReason R → Bool
344	    | .error e => e == unknownAtom n
345	    | _ => false
346	  let isUnknownQ : QR → Bool
347	    | .error e => e == unknownAtom n
348	    | _ => false
349	  !(isUnknown (evalAtomE s n [] []) && isUnknownQ (evalMeasure s n []))

351	/-- The sort each entity argument of an atom must have (`none` marks a literal position): by
352	    family, with the mixed atoms listed. `none` for a name the tables do not know. -/
353	def atomArgSorts (name : String) : Option (List (Option EntityKind)) :=
354	  let t := some EntityKind.track; let r := some EntityKind.region; let d := some EntityKind.device
355	  match name with
356	  | "rel_occupies" => some [t, r]
357	  | "ru_aggregate" => some [t, none]
358	  | "dev_governs" => some [d, r]
359	  | "st_region_geometry_distance" | "st_sight_along_way" => some [t, r]
360	  | "st_lane_adjacency" => some [r, none, r]
361	  | "st_lane_adjacency_left" | "st_lane_adjacency_right" | "st_lane_connectivity" | "st_lane_enters" | "st_on_way"
362	  | "st_entrance_of" => some [r, r]
363	  | "st_lane_marking" => some [r, none, none, none]
364	  | "rel_oncoming" | "rel_same_direction" | "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" | "rel_ahead_in_lane"
365	  | "rel_behind_in_lane" | "rel_contact" | "rel_visible" | "rel_centre_distance" | "rel_longitudinal_overlap" => some [t, t]
366	  | "rel_surface_gap" | "rel_bearing" => some [t, t, none]
367	  | n =>
368	    if !knowsAtom n then none
369	    else if n.startsWith "env_" || n == "kin_time" then some []
370	    else if n.startsWith "ru_" || n.startsWith "kin_" || n.startsWith "sig_" then some [t, none, none]
371	    else if n.startsWith "st_" then some [r, none, none]
372	    else if n.startsWith "dev_" then some [d, none, none]
373	    else none

381	def constU (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : Array R := const n (R.u w)
382	def constE (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : Array QR := Array.replicate n (.error w)
383	def liftA (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array R)) : Array R :=
384	  match e with | .ok a => a | .error w => constU n w
385	def liftQ (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array QR)) : Array QR :=
386	  match e with | .ok a => a | .error w => constE n w
387	def qzip (f : Q → Q → Q) (a b : Array QR) : Array QR :=
388	  Array.zipWith (fun x y => do pure (f (← x) (← y))) a b

390	/-- A term that names no instant: a literal, a parameter or arithmetic over those. Only such a
391	    term may parametrize an atom or a derived concept. -/
392	partial def Term.isConstant : Term → Bool
393	  | .lit _ _ | .param _ => true
394	  | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => Term.isConstant a && Term.isConstant b
395	  | .neg a | .abs a => Term.isConstant a
396	  | _ => false

398	/-- The single value of a constant term's per-instant array. -/
399	def constOf (t : Term) (arr : Array QR) : Except UnknownReason Q := do
400	  if !Term.isConstant t then throw (.malformed "parameter is not a constant term")
401	  arr[0]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)

446	/-- φ where the precondition holds; undefined where it is false; the precondition's reasons where
447	    it is unknown. -/
448	def definedWhenR (pre x : R) : R :=
449	  match pre.v with
450	  | .t => x
451	  | .f => R.u (.undefined "defined_when")
452	  | .u => ⟨.u, pre.why⟩

454	/-- A selection at one instant: the branch the guard picks; where the guard is unknown, the
455	    branches' common value, else unknown with the guard's reasons. -/
456	def condAt (g : R) (a b : QR) : QR :=
457	  match g.v with
458	  | .t => a
459	  | .f => b
460	  | .u => match a, b with
461	    | .ok x, .ok y => if Q.eq x y then .ok x else .error (g.why.head?.getD (.malformed "cond"))
462	    | _, _ => .error (g.why.head?.getD (.malformed "cond"))
463	
464	/-- An aggregate over the members present at one instant: unknown when a member's membership is
465	    unknown or a member's value is; `count` on an empty set is zero, the others are undefined. -/
466	def aggregateAt (op : AggOp) (xs : List (R × QR)) : QR :=
467	  match xs.find? (fun (f, _) => f.v == .u) with
468	  | some (f, _) => .error (f.why.head?.getD (.malformed "aggregate"))
469	  | none =>
470	    let vals := xs.filterMap fun (f, q) => if f.v == .t then some q else none
471	    match op with
472	    | .count => .ok (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat vals.length))
473	    | _ => do
474	      let qs ← vals.mapM fun q => q
475	      if qs.isEmpty then .error (.undefined "aggregate")
476	      else
477	        let sorted := qs.toArray.qsort (fun a b => Q.lt a b)
478	        match op with
479	        | .min => .ok sorted[0]!
480	        | .max => .ok sorted[sorted.size - 1]!
481	        | _ => .ok sorted[sorted.size / 2]!
482	
483	/-- Membership of a road user in a legal aggregate at one scene: true when it carries an included
484	    class; unknown, with the observation's reason, when an included or unresolved class it might
485	    carry is unobserved; unknown as `aggregateUnresolved` when it carries a class the definition
486	    leaves unresolved; false otherwise. -/
487	def aggregateMembership (s : Scene) (t : TrackId) (a : LegalAggregate) : R :=
488	  let classes := fun (ids : List String) => ids.filterMap fun i => RoadUserClass.ofString (i.drop 3).toString
489	  match ru_aggregate s t (classes a.included) with
490	  | some true => R.t
491	  | none => R.u (.absentAtom "ru_aggregate")
492	  | some false =>
493	    match ru_aggregate s t (classes a.unresolved) with
494	    | some true => R.u (.aggregateUnresolved a.id)
495	    | some false => R.f
496	    | none => R.u (.absentAtom "ru_aggregate")

498	/-- Kleene aggregate at each instant over the evaluated members present in that scene. -/
499	def perScene (c : SemCtx) (evaluated : List (Nat × Array R))
500	    (presentIn : Scene → Nat → Bool) (agg : List R → R) : Array R :=
501	  (Array.range c.n).map fun i =>
502	    let s := c.scenes[i]!
503	    agg (evaluated.filterMap fun (m, arr) => if presentIn s m then some arr[i]! else none)

505	mutual
506	  def evalTAll (c : SemCtx) : Term → Array QR
507	    | .lit v _ => Array.replicate c.n (.ok v)
508	    | .param p => Array.replicate c.n (match c.d.ρ.param p with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.parameterMissing p))
509	    | .measure a args =>
510	      match resolveAll c.β args with
511	      | .error w => constE c.n w
512	      | .ok ds => c.scenes.map fun s => evalMeasure s a ds
513	    | .quantity concept args ps =>
514	      liftQ c.n do
515	        let vs ← constParams c ps
516	        Primitives.evalQ concept c.d (← resolveAll c.β args) vs
517	    | .distanceWhile subj φ =>
518	      match c.β.track subj with
519	      | none => constE c.n (.unboundVariable subj)
520	      | some x => Primitives.distanceWhile c.d x (evalAll c φ)
521	    | .sinceRise φ => sinceRiseAll c.d.times (evalAll c φ)
522	    | .headingSince subj g ψ =>
523	      match c.β.track subj with
524	      | none => constE c.n (.unboundVariable subj)
525	      | some x => liftQ c.n do
526	          let gv ← stepOf g (evalTAll c g)
527	          pure (Primitives.headingSince c.d x gv (evalAll c ψ))
528	    | .aggregate op v φ t =>
529	      let members := (usersOf c).map fun u =>
530	        let c' := c.bindVar v (.track u)
531	        (u, evalAll c' φ, evalTAll c' t)
532	      (Array.range c.n).map fun i =>
533	        let s := c.scenes[i]!
534	        aggregateAt op (members.filterMap fun (u, fa, ta) => if s.tracks.contains u then some (fa[i]!, ta[i]!) else none)
535	    | .add a b' => qzip Q.add (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
536	    | .sub a b' => qzip Q.sub (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
537	    | .mul a b' => qzip Q.mul (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
538	    | .div a b' => Array.zipWith (fun x y => do
539	        let d ← y
540	        if Q.isZero d then .error (.divisionByZero "div") else pure (Q.div (← x) d)) (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
541	    | .neg a => (evalTAll c a).map (·.map Q.neg)
542	    | .abs a => (evalTAll c a).map (·.map Q.abs)
543	    | .cond φ a b' =>
544	      let g := evalAll c φ; let x := evalTAll c a; let y := evalTAll c b'
545	      (Array.range c.n).map fun i => condAt (g[i]?.getD (R.u .outOfRange)) (x[i]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)) (y[i]?.getD (.error .outOfRange))
546	  termination_by t => sizeOf t
547	
548	  /-- Parameters of an atom or derived concept: constant terms, evaluated once. -/
549	  def constParams (c : SemCtx) : List Term → Except UnknownReason (List Q)
550	    | [] => .ok []
551	    | t :: rest => do
552	      let v ← constOf t (evalTAll c t)
553	      pure (v :: (← constParams c rest))
554	  termination_by ts => sizeOf ts

556	  def evalAll (c : SemCtx) : Formula → Array R
557	    | .tt => const c.n R.t
558	    | .ff => const c.n R.f
559	    | .atom name args ps =>
560	      liftA c.n do
561	        let vs ← constParams c ps
562	        let ds ← resolveAll c.β args
563	        if name == "ru_aggregate" then
564	          pure (match ds with
565	            | [.v t, .s id] =>
566	              match c.d.aggregateOverrides.find? (fun (x, a, _) => x == t && a == id) with
567	              | some (_, _, v) => const c.n (R.ofBool v)
568	              | none =>
569	                match c.d.ρ.aggregate id with
570	                | none => const c.n (R.u (.parameterMissing s!"aggregate:{id}"))
571	                | some a => c.scenes.map fun s => aggregateMembership s t a
572	            | _ => const c.n (R.u (.malformed "aggregate arguments")))
573	        else pure (c.scenes.map fun s => match evalAtomE s name ds vs with | .ok r => r | .error w => R.u w)
574	    | .cmp l op r => Array.zipWith (fun x y => match x, y with
575	        | .ok a, .ok b => R.ofBool (op.apply a b)
576	        | .error w, _ | _, .error w => R.u w) (evalTAll c l) (evalTAll c r)
577	    | .asm id => c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (s.assumption id) (.assumptionMissing id)
578	    | .intent id who target =>
579	      match who, target with
580	      | .var a, .var b =>
581	        match c.β.lookup a, c.β.lookup b with
582	        | some (.track x), some (.region r) => c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (s.intention id x r) (.intentionMissing id)
583	        | none, _ => constU c.n (.unboundVariable a)
584	        | _, none => constU c.n (.unboundVariable b)
585	        | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "intent: a track and a region expected")
586	      | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "intent: a track and a region expected")
587	    | .same a b =>
588	      match resolve c.β a, resolve c.β b with
589	      | .ok (.v i), .ok (.v j) => const c.n (R.ofBool (i == j))
590	      | .error w, _ | _, .error w => constU c.n w
591	      | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "same: entities expected")
592	    | .not φ => mapNot (evalAll c φ)
593	    -- a connective whose left operand settles it at every instant does not evaluate its right one
594	    | .and φ ψ =>
595	      let a := evalAll c φ
596	      if a.all (·.v == .f) then a.map (fun _ => R.f) else zipAnd a (evalAll c ψ)
597	    | .or φ ψ =>
598	      let a := evalAll c φ
599	      if a.all (·.v == .t) then a.map (fun _ => R.t) else zipOr a (evalAll c ψ)
600	    | .implies φ ψ =>
601	      let a := evalAll c φ
602	      if a.all (·.v == .f) then a.map (fun _ => R.t) else zipImplies a (evalAll c ψ)
603	    | .always φ => alwaysAll (evalAll c φ)
604	    | .eventually φ => eventuallyAll (evalAll c φ)
605	    | .until φ ψ => untilAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ)
606	    | .since φ ψ => sinceAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ)
607	    | .holdsFor m d subj φ =>
608	      liftA c.n do
609	        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
610	        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
611	        pure (holdsForAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "holdsFor" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ))
612	    | .within m d subj φ =>
613	      liftA c.n do
614	        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
615	        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
616	        pure (withinAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "within" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ))
617	    | .untilWithin m d subj φ ψ =>
618	      liftA c.n do
619	        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
620	        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
621	        pure (untilWithinAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "untilWithin" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ))
622	    | .atLast m d subj ψ φ =>
623	      liftA c.n do
624	        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
625	        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
626	        pure (atLastAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "atLast" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c ψ) (evalAll c φ))
627	    | .count edge sinceφ op k =>
628	      (countEdgesAll "count" (evalAll c edge) (evalAll c sinceφ)).map fun e => match e with
629	        | .error w => R.u w
630	        | .ok m => R.ofBool (op.apply (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat m)) (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)))
631	    | .rises φ => risesAll (evalAll c φ)
632	    | .definedWhen pre φ => Array.zipWith definedWhenR (evalAll c pre) (evalAll c φ)
633	    | .derived concept args ps =>
634	      liftA c.n do
635	        let vs ← constParams c ps
636	        Primitives.evalB concept c.d (← resolveAll c.β args) vs
637	    | .rule id map =>
638	      let arr := c.compose id map c.β false
639	      if arr.size = c.n then arr else constU c.n (.compositionUnknown id)
640	    | .ruleApplies id map =>
641	      let arr := c.compose id map c.β true
642	      if arr.size = c.n then arr else constU c.n (.compositionUnknown id)
643	    | .existsUser v φ =>
644	      perScene c ((usersOf c).map fun t => (t, evalAll (c.bindVar v (.track t)) φ))
645	        (fun s t => s.tracks.contains t) R.any
646	    | .forallUser v φ =>
647	      perScene c ((usersOf c).map fun t => (t, evalAll (c.bindVar v (.track t)) φ))
648	        (fun s t => s.tracks.contains t) R.all
649	    | .existsRegion k v φ =>
650	      match regionKindOf k with
651	      | .error w => constU c.n w
652	      | .ok kd => perScene c ((regionsOf c kd).map fun r =>
653	            (r, Array.zipWith R.and (regionIsKind c r kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.region r)) φ)))
654	          (fun s r => (s.structure? r).isSome) R.any
655	    | .forallRegion k v φ =>
656	      match regionKindOf k with
657	      | .error w => constU c.n w
658	      | .ok kd => perScene c ((regionsOf c kd).map fun r =>
659	            (r, Array.zipWith R.implies (regionIsKind c r kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.region r)) φ)))
660	          (fun s r => (s.structure? r).isSome) R.all
661	    | .existsDevice k v φ =>
662	      match deviceKindOf k with
663	      | .error w => constU c.n w
664	      | .ok kd => perScene c ((devicesOf c kd).map fun d =>
665	            (d, Array.zipWith R.and (deviceIsKind c d kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.device d)) φ)))
666	          (fun s d => (s.device d).isSome) R.any
667	    | .forallDevice k v φ =>
668	      match deviceKindOf k with
669	      | .error w => constU c.n w
670	      | .ok kd => perScene c ((devicesOf c kd).map fun d =>
671	            (d, Array.zipWith R.implies (deviceIsKind c d kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.device d)) φ)))
672	          (fun s d => (s.device d).isSome) R.all
673	  termination_by φ => sizeOf φ
674	end
675	
676	/-- The value of a formula at instant `i`. -/
677	def eval (c : SemCtx) (i : Nat) (φ : Formula) : R := (evalAll c φ)[i]?.getD (R.u .outOfRange)
678	def evalTri (c : SemCtx) (i : Nat) (φ : Formula) : Tri := (eval c i φ).v

681	-- Lengths: every formula and every term has exactly one value per observation of the trace.
682	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
683	section Lengths
684	
685	private theorem n_bindVar (c : SemCtx) (v : String) (x : Val) : (c.bindVar v x).n = c.n := rfl
686	private theorem size_constU (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : (constU n w).size = n := by
687	  simp [constU, Temporal.size_const]
688	private theorem size_constE (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : (constE n w).size = n := by simp [constE]
689	private theorem size_liftA (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array R))
690	    (h : ∀ a, e = .ok a → a.size = n) : (liftA n e).size = n := by
691	  unfold liftA; cases e with
692	  | ok a => exact h a rfl
693	  | error w => exact size_constU n w
694	private theorem size_liftQ (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array QR))
695	    (h : ∀ a, e = .ok a → a.size = n) : (liftQ n e).size = n := by
696	  unfold liftQ; cases e with
697	  | ok a => exact h a rfl

699	private theorem size_qzip (f : Q → Q → Q) (a b : Array QR) : (qzip f a b).size = min a.size b.size := by

702	    (agg : List R → R) : (perScene c ev p agg).size = c.n := by simp [perScene]

705	  theorem size_evalTAll (c : SemCtx) : ∀ t : Term, (evalTAll c t).size = c.n
706	    | .lit _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
707	    | .param _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
708	    | .measure _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; split <;> simp [size_constE, SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
709	    | .quantity _ args ps => by
710	        rw [evalTAll]; apply size_liftQ; intro a h
711	        cases hv : constParams c ps <;> cases hr : resolveAll c.β args <;>
712	          simp only [hv, hr, bind, Except.bind] at h <;> try contradiction
713	        exact Primitives.size_evalQ _ _ _ _ _ h

715	        rw [evalTAll]; split
716	        · exact size_constE _ _
717	        · rw [Primitives.size_distanceWhile]; exact size_evalAll c φ
718	    | .sinceRise φ => by rw [evalTAll, Temporal.size_sinceRiseAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
719	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => by

721	        · exact size_constE _ _
722	        · apply size_liftQ; intro a h
723	          cases hg : stepOf g (evalTAll c g) <;> simp only [hg, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;>

725	          cases h; rw [Primitives.size_headingSince]; exact size_evalAll c ψ
726	    | .aggregate _ _ _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
727	    | .add a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
728	    | .sub a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
729	    | .mul a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
730	    | .div a b => by rw [evalTAll, Array.size_zipWith, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]

732	    | .abs a => by rw [evalTAll, Array.size_map]; exact size_evalTAll c a
733	    | .cond _ _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp

737	    | .tt => by rw [evalAll]; exact Temporal.size_const _ _
738	    | .ff => by rw [evalAll]; exact Temporal.size_const _ _
739	    | .atom name args ps => by
740	        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
741	        cases hv : constParams c ps <;> cases hr : resolveAll c.β args <;>
742	          simp only [hv, hr, bind, Except.bind] at h <;> try contradiction
743	        split at h
744	        · cases h; split
745	          · split
746	            · exact Temporal.size_const _ _
747	            · split
748	              · exact Temporal.size_const _ _
749	              · simp [SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]

752	    | .cmp l _ r => by rw [evalAll, Array.size_zipWith, size_evalTAll c l, size_evalTAll c r, Nat.min_self]
753	    | .asm _ => by rw [evalAll]; simp [SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]

758	        rw [evalAll]; split <;> simp [size_constU, Temporal.size_const]
759	    | .not φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_mapNot]; exact size_evalAll c φ
760	    | .and φ ψ => by
761	        rw [evalAll]; split
762	        · rw [Array.size_map]; exact size_evalAll c φ
763	        · rw [Temporal.size_zipAnd, size_evalAll c φ, size_evalAll c ψ, Nat.min_self]
764	    | .or φ ψ => by
765	        rw [evalAll]; split
766	        · rw [Array.size_map]; exact size_evalAll c φ
767	        · rw [Temporal.size_zipOr, size_evalAll c φ, size_evalAll c ψ, Nat.min_self]
768	    | .implies φ ψ => by
769	        rw [evalAll]; split

771	        · rw [Temporal.size_zipImplies, size_evalAll c φ, size_evalAll c ψ, Nat.min_self]
772	    | .always φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_alwaysAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ

774	    | .until φ ψ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_untilAll]; exact size_evalAll c ψ
775	    | .since φ ψ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_sinceAll]; exact size_evalAll c ψ

778	        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>

780	        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_holdsForAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
781	    | .within m d s φ => by

783	        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>

785	        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_withinAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
786	    | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => by

788	        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>
789	          simp only [hx, hd, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;> try contradiction
790	        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_untilWithinAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
791	    | .atLast m d s ψ φ => by
792	        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
793	        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>
794	          simp only [hx, hd, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;> try contradiction
795	        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_atLastAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
796	    | .count edge sφ _ _ => by rw [evalAll, Array.size_map, Temporal.size_countEdgesAll]; exact size_evalAll c edge
797	    | .rises φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_risesAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
798	    | .definedWhen pre φ => by rw [evalAll, Array.size_zipWith, size_evalAll c pre, size_evalAll c φ, Nat.min_self]
799	    | .derived _ args ps => by
800	        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
801	        cases hv : constParams c ps <;> cases hr : resolveAll c.β args <;>
802	          simp only [hv, hr, bind, Except.bind] at h <;> try contradiction
803	        exact Primitives.size_evalB _ _ _ _ _ h
804	    | .rule _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split <;> simp_all [size_constU]
805	    | .ruleApplies _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split <;> simp_all [size_constU]
806	    | .existsUser _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
807	    | .forallUser _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
808	    | .existsRegion _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
809	    | .forallRegion _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
810	    | .existsDevice _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
811	    | .forallDevice _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _

827	  rcases a with ⟨av, aw⟩; subst h; simp [R.and, R.settle, Tri.and, R.f]

831	  rcases a with ⟨av, aw⟩; subst h; simp [R.implies, R.not, R.or, R.settle, Tri.not, Tri.or, R.t]

833	/-- A connective is the pointwise three-valued operation of its operands' arrays, whether or not
834	    its right operand was evaluated: where the left one settles it at every instant, both arrays
835	    have one value per observation and every pointwise value is the settled one. -/
836	theorem evalAll_and : evalAll c (.and φ ψ) = Array.zipWith R.and (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by
837	  rw [evalAll]; split
838	  · rename_i h
839	    rw [Array.all_eq_true] at h
840	    apply Array.ext
841	    · simp [size_evalAll]
842	    · intro i h1 h2
843	      simp only [Array.getElem_map, Array.getElem_zipWith]
844	      rw [and_of_f _ _ (by simpa using h i (by simpa using h1))]
845	  · rfl

847	  rw [evalAll]; split
848	  · rename_i h

850	    apply Array.ext
851	    · simp [size_evalAll]
852	    · intro i h1 h2

854	      rw [or_of_t _ _ (by simpa using h i (by simpa using h1))]
855	  · rfl

862	    · intro i h1 h2

864	      rw [implies_of_f _ _ (by simpa using h i (by simpa using h1))]
865	  · rfl

867	theorem evalAll_eventually : evalAll c (.eventually φ) = eventuallyAll (evalAll c φ) := by rw [evalAll]
868	theorem evalAll_until : evalAll c (.until φ ψ) = untilAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by rw [evalAll]
869	theorem evalAll_since : evalAll c (.since φ ψ) = sinceAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by rw [evalAll]
870	theorem evalAll_rule (id : String) (map : List (String × String)) (h : (c.compose id map c.β false).size = c.n) :
871	    evalAll c (.rule id map) = c.compose id map c.β false := by rw [evalAll]; simp [h]
872	theorem evalAll_ruleApplies (id : String) (map : List (String × String)) (h : (c.compose id map c.β true).size = c.n) :
873	    evalAll c (.ruleApplies id map) = c.compose id map c.β true := by rw [evalAll]; simp [h]
874	
875	/-- The heading-change term is the accumulation operator over its onset's values. -/
876	theorem evalTAll_headingSince (s : String) (g : Term) (x : TrackId) (gv : Q)
877	    (hx : c.β.track s = some x) (hg : stepOf g (evalTAll c g) = .ok gv) :
878	    evalTAll c (.headingSince s g ψ) = Primitives.headingSince c.d x gv (evalAll c ψ) := by
879	  rw [evalTAll]; simp only [hx, hg, liftQ, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure]

881	theorem eval_not_u (i : Nat) (h : (eval c i φ).v = .u) (hi : i < (evalAll c φ).size) : (eval c i (.not φ)).v = .u := by
882	  unfold eval at *

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Semantics
  The meaning of a formula over a trace: one three-valued result with reasons per instant.

  `evalAll` evaluates a formula bottom-up, each subformula once for the whole trace, so a formula
  costs O(|φ| · n log n) per binding: atoms map a scene function over the instants, the temporal
  operators are the single-pass operators of Temporal.lean, quantifiers evaluate their body once
  per region or device present anywhere in the trace. `eval c i φ` is the value at instant i.

  Atoms and derived concepts are dispatched by name to the definitions of Atoms.lean and
  Primitives.lean; a name the tables do not know, a wrong arity, a literal that spells no
  enumeration value or a variable of the wrong sort is `unknown (malformed …)`. The static check
  (RuleEval.check) finds every such defect from the syntax before any trace is read, so a checked
  rule reports at evaluation time only source absence, truncation, sampling gaps, undefined
  concept preconditions, division by zero and unknown compositions.

  Finite-trace policy — unobserved is unknown, never compliance:
  - `holdsFor` needs its whole window observed at adequate density, else unknown;
  - `within`/`untilWithin` are true on a witness, false only when the window is covered;
  - `eventually`/`until` carry the unobserved future, `since` the unobserved past, and `always`
    the unobserved future as unknown: on a finite trace `always φ` is false or unknown, never true.
    A rule's obligation is written for an instant; the sweep over instants (Grounding) is the
    "always".

  Rule composition is a callback, because the library of rules is defined above this file.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Primitives
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Intentions

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Semantics

open Primitives (DArg)
open Temporal

/-- Everything an evaluation needs: the indexed trace with its reading, the bindings, and how to
    evaluate another rule's obligation (`rule id map`) under a variable map, per instant. -/
structure SemCtx where
  d : Primitives.Ctx
  β : Binding := {}
  /-- Another rule's verdict per instant under a variable map: complied-with when `engaged` is
      false, engaged (classes and applicability) when true. -/
  compose : String → List (String × String) → Binding → Bool → Array R :=
    fun _ _ _ _ => #[]

namespace SemCtx
def n (c : SemCtx) : Nat := c.d.n
def scenes (c : SemCtx) : Array Scene := c.d.scenes
def bindVar (c : SemCtx) (v : String) (x : Val) : SemCtx := { c with β := c.β.bind v x }
def mk' (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) (β : Binding := {}) : SemCtx := { d := Primitives.Ctx.mk' τ ρ, β := β }
end SemCtx

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Arguments
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def resolve (β : Binding) : Arg → Except UnknownReason DArg
  | .var v =>
    match β.lookup v with
    | some (.track t) => .ok (.v t)
    | some (.region r) => .ok (.v r)
    | some (.device d) => .ok (.v d)
    | none => .error (.unboundVariable v)
  | .lit s => .ok (.s s)
  | .nat k => .ok (.n k)

def resolveAll (β : Binding) (args : List Arg) : Except UnknownReason (List DArg) := args.mapM (resolve β)

private def ent (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason Nat :=
  match a with | .v t => .ok t | .n k => .ok k | .s _ => .error (.malformed "entity expected")
private def lit (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason String :=
  match a with | .s s => .ok s | _ => .error (.malformed "literal expected")
private def enumLit {α : Type} (ofString : String → Option α) (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason α := do
  let s ← lit a
  match ofString s with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.malformed s)

private def b (o : Option Bool) (name : String) : R := R.ofOption o (.absentAtom name)
private def eqEnum {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (o : Option α) (v : α) (name : String) : R :=
  b (o.map (· == v)) name
private def q (o : Option Q) (name : String) : QR :=
  match o with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
private def qn (o : Option Nat) (name : String) : QR :=
  match o with | some v => .ok (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat v)) | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
private def qz (o : Option Int) (name : String) : QR :=
  match o with | some v => .ok (Q.ofInt v) | none => .error (.absentAtom name)

def unknownAtom (n : String) : UnknownReason := .malformed s!"atom {n}"
def arity (n : String) : UnknownReason := .malformed s!"arity {n}"

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Boolean atoms by name, on one scene. Class atoms (`ru_*`, `st_*`, `dev_*` kinds) are dispatched
-- through the generated codecs, so the table cannot drift from ATOMS.md; attribute atoms are listed.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def evalAtomE (s : Scene) (name : String) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) : Except UnknownReason R := do
  match name, args with
  -- road users
  | "ru_subject", [x] => pure (b (ru_subject s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_aggregate", [_, .s w] => .error (.parameterMissing s!"aggregate:{w}")   -- resolved with the reading in `evalAll`
  | "ru_rider_posture", [x, f] =>
    match f with
    | .s "on_seat" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_on_seat s (← ent x)) name)
    | .s "standing_on_deck" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_standing_on_deck s (← ent x)) name)
    | .s "holding_another_vehicle" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_holding_another_vehicle s (← ent x)) name)
    | .s "stunt" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_stunt s (← ent x)) name)
    | _ => .error (.malformed "posture field")
  | "ru_rider_posture_on_seat", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_on_seat s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_rider_posture_standing_on_deck", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_standing_on_deck s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_rider_posture_holding_another_vehicle", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_holding_another_vehicle s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_rider_posture_stunt", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_stunt s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_emergency_vehicle_kind", [x, k] => pure (eqEnum (ru_emergency_vehicle_kind s (← ent x)) (← enumLit EmergencyKind.ofString k) name)
  | "ru_official_vehicle_kind", [x, k] => pure (eqEnum (ru_official_vehicle_kind s (← ent x)) (← enumLit OfficialKind.ofString k) name)
  -- control state
  | "kin_engine_running", [x] => pure (b (kin_engine_running s (← ent x)) name)
  | "kin_parking_brake", [x] => pure (b (kin_parking_brake s (← ent x)) name)
  -- structure attributes
  | "st_road_edge_paved", [r] => pure (b (st_road_edge_paved s (← ent r)) name)
  | "st_shoulder_paved", [r] => pure (b (st_shoulder_paved s (← ent r)) name)
  | "st_median_or_divider_opening", [r] => pure (b (st_median_or_divider_opening s (← ent r)) name)
  | "st_crosswalk_marked", [r] => pure (b (st_crosswalk_marked s (← ent r)) name)
  | "st_reserved_lane_class", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_reserved_lane_class s (← ent r)) (← enumLit ReservedClass.ofString k) name)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Measured atoms by name (quantity-valued), on one scene. Vector atoms take a component literal.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def comp (v : Option Vec) (k : DArg) (name : String) : QR := do
  match k with
  | .s "x" => q (v.map (·.1)) name
  | .s "y" => q (v.map (·.2)) name
  | _ => .error (.malformed "component")

def evalMeasure (s : Scene) (name : String) (args : List DArg) : QR := do
  match name, args with
  | "kin_time", [] => .ok (Time.ofTimestamp (kin_time s))
  | "kin_position", [x, k] => comp (kin_position s (← ent x)) k name
  | "kin_heading", [x, k] => comp ((kin_heading s (← ent x)).bind Geom.unit) k name
  | "kin_velocity", [x, k] => comp (kin_velocity s (← ent x)) k name
  | "kin_speed", [x] => q (kin_speed s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_accel_longitudinal", [x] => q (kin_accel_longitudinal s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_yaw_rate", [x] => q (kin_yaw_rate s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_extent", [x, k] =>
    let e := kin_extent s (← ent x)
    match k with   -- full extents: twice the half-extent
    | .s "length" => q (e.map fun (l, _, _) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) l) name
    | .s "width" => q (e.map fun (_, w, _) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) w) name
    | .s "height" => q (e.map fun (_, _, h) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) h) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "extent")
  | "kin_steer_angle", [x] => q (kin_steer_angle s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_path_length", [x] => q (kin_path_length s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_gear", [x] => qz (kin_gear s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_throttle", [x] => q (kin_throttle s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_service_brake", [x] => q (kin_service_brake s (← ent x)) name
  | "ru_occupant_count", [x] => qn (ru_occupant_count s (← ent x)) name
  | "ru_rider_posture_hands_on_controls", [x] => qn (ru_rider_posture_hands_on_controls s (← ent x)) name
  | "ru_electric_bicycle_class", [x] => qn (ru_electric_bicycle_class s (← ent x)) name
  | "st_lane_direction", [r, k] => comp ((st_lane_direction s (← ent r)).bind Geom.unit) k name
  | "st_lane_adjacency", [r, k] =>
    match k with
    | .s "ordinal" => qn (st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s (← ent r)) name
    | .s "count" => qn (st_lane_adjacency_count s (← ent r)) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "adjacency field")
  | "st_lane_adjacency_ordinal", [r] => qn (st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_lane_adjacency_count", [r] => qn (st_lane_adjacency_count s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_lane_width", [r] => q (st_lane_width s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_curvature", [r] => q (st_curvature s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_grade", [r] => q (st_grade s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_sight_distance", [r] => q (st_sight_distance s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_sight_along_way", [x, w] => q (st_sight_along_way s (← ent x) (← ent w)) name
  | "st_parking_space_angle", [r] => q (st_parking_space_angle s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_region_geometry", [r, k] => comp (st_region_geometry_position s (← ent r)) k name
  | "st_region_geometry_distance", [x, r] => q (st_region_geometry_distance s (← ent x) (← ent r)) name
  | "dev_position", [d, k] => comp (dev_position s (← ent d)) k name
  | "dev_speed_limit_sign_value", [d] => q (dev_speed_limit_sign_value s (← ent d)) name
  | "env_visibility", [] => q (env_visibility s) name
  | "env_civil_time", [k] =>
    let ct := env_civil_time s
    match k with
    | .s "minute_of_day" => qn (ct.map (·.minuteOfDay)) name
    | .s "weekday" => qn (ct.map (·.weekday)) name
    | .s "month" => qn (ct.map (·.month)) name
    | .s "day" => qn (ct.map (·.day)) name
    | .s "year" => qn (ct.map (·.year)) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "civil time field")
  | "rel_centre_distance", [a, a'] => q (rel_centre_distance s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name
  | "rel_surface_gap", [a, a'] => q (rel_surface_gap_distance s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name
  | "rel_surface_gap", [a, a', k] =>
    match k with
    | .s "longitudinal" => q (rel_surface_gap_longitudinal s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name
    | .s "lateral" => q (rel_surface_gap_lateral s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "gap component")
  | "rel_longitudinal_overlap", [a, a'] => q (rel_longitudinal_overlap s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name
  | "rel_bearing", [a, a', k] => comp (rel_bearing s (← ent a) (← ent a')) k name
  | n, _ => if measureNames.contains n then .error (arity n) else .error (unknownAtom n)
