    "st_sight_distance", "st_sight_along_way", "st_parking_space_angle", "st_region_geometry", "st_region_geometry_distance",
    "dev_position", "dev_speed_limit_sign_value", "env_visibility", "env_civil_time",
    "rel_centre_distance", "rel_surface_gap", "rel_longitudinal_overlap", "rel_bearing"]

/-- Whether a name is known to either table (the doctor holds this against `atomIds`). -/
def knowsAtom (n : String) : Bool :=
  let s : Scene := { t := 0 }
  let isUnknown : Except UnknownReason R → Bool
    | .error e => e == unknownAtom n
    | _ => false
  let isUnknownQ : QR → Bool
    | .error e => e == unknownAtom n
    | _ => false
  !(isUnknown (evalAtomE s n [] []) && isUnknownQ (evalMeasure s n []))

/-- The sort each entity argument of an atom must have (`none` marks a literal position): by
    family, with the mixed atoms listed. `none` for a name the tables do not know. -/
def atomArgSorts (name : String) : Option (List (Option EntityKind)) :=
  let t := some EntityKind.track; let r := some EntityKind.region; let d := some EntityKind.device
  match name with
  | "rel_occupies" => some [t, r]
  | "ru_aggregate" => some [t, none]
  | "dev_governs" => some [d, r]
  | "st_region_geometry_distance" | "st_sight_along_way" => some [t, r]
  | "st_lane_adjacency" => some [r, none, r]
  | "st_lane_adjacency_left" | "st_lane_adjacency_right" | "st_lane_connectivity" | "st_lane_enters" | "st_on_way"
  | "st_entrance_of" => some [r, r]
  | "st_lane_marking" => some [r, none, none, none]
  | "rel_oncoming" | "rel_same_direction" | "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" | "rel_ahead_in_lane"
  | "rel_behind_in_lane" | "rel_contact" | "rel_visible" | "rel_centre_distance" | "rel_longitudinal_overlap" => some [t, t]
  | "rel_surface_gap" | "rel_bearing" => some [t, t, none]
  | n =>
    if !knowsAtom n then none
    else if n.startsWith "env_" || n == "kin_time" then some []
    else if n.startsWith "ru_" || n.startsWith "kin_" || n.startsWith "sig_" then some [t, none, none]
    else if n.startsWith "st_" then some [r, none, none]
    else if n.startsWith "dev_" then some [d, none, none]
    else none

/-- The Lean name of an ATOMS.md id or attribute path (`dev.traffic_signal.shows` ↦ `dev_traffic_signal_shows`). -/
def defName (id : String) : String := id.replace "." "_"

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The evaluator: every subformula once, over the whole trace.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def constU (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : Array R := const n (R.u w)
def constE (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : Array QR := Array.replicate n (.error w)
def liftA (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array R)) : Array R :=
  match e with | .ok a => a | .error w => constU n w
def liftQ (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array QR)) : Array QR :=
  match e with | .ok a => a | .error w => constE n w
def qzip (f : Q → Q → Q) (a b : Array QR) : Array QR :=
  Array.zipWith (fun x y => do pure (f (← x) (← y))) a b

/-- A term that names no instant: a literal, a parameter or arithmetic over those. Only such a
    term may parametrize an atom or a derived concept. -/
partial def Term.isConstant : Term → Bool
  | .lit _ _ | .param _ => true
  | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => Term.isConstant a && Term.isConstant b
  | .neg a | .abs a => Term.isConstant a
  | _ => false

/-- The single value of a constant term's per-instant array. -/
def constOf (t : Term) (arr : Array QR) : Except UnknownReason Q := do
  if !Term.isConstant t then throw (.malformed "parameter is not a constant term")
  arr[0]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)

/-- The value of a heading change's step bound: a literal or a reading parameter, read as `constOf`
    reads a constant; any other term is malformed. -/
def stepOf (t : Term) (arr : Array QR) : Except UnknownReason Q :=
  match t with
  | .lit _ _ | .param _ => arr[0]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)
  | _ => .error (.malformed "heading_since step bound is not a literal or a reading parameter")

/-- The subject variable of a window: needed for path windows, irrelevant for time windows. -/
def subjectFor (β : Binding) (m : Measure) (v : String) : Except UnknownReason TrackId :=
  match m with
  | .time => .ok 0
  | .path => match β.track v with | some t => .ok t | none => .error (.unboundVariable v)

/-- Every region a quantifier over a kind ranges over in some scene of the trace: those whose
    membership of the kind is not false there (`regionCandidates`). -/
def regionsOf (c : SemCtx) (k : StructureKind) : List RegionId :=
  (c.scenes.toList.flatMap fun s => regionCandidates s k).eraseDups
def devicesOf (c : SemCtx) (k : DeviceKind) : List DeviceId :=
  (c.scenes.toList.flatMap fun s => deviceCandidates s k).eraseDups
/-- At each instant, whether the region is of the kind: true, false, or unknown where the source
    cannot tell the kind. A quantifier conjoins it with its body, so a region the source cannot
    place in the kind makes the quantifier unknown, never decided by its absence. -/
def regionIsKind (c : SemCtx) (r : RegionId) (k : StructureKind) : Array R :=
  c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (isKind s r k) (.absentAtom s!"st_{k}")
def deviceIsKind (c : SemCtx) (d : DeviceId) (k : DeviceKind) : Array R :=
  c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (devKind s d k) (.absentAtom s!"dev_{k}")
/-- Every road user present in some scene of the trace. -/
def usersOf (c : SemCtx) : List TrackId :=
  (c.scenes.toList.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups

/-- The kind a quantifier ranges over: a spelling of the ontology. A variable here is a concept's
    literal formal that no expansion filled. -/
def regionKindOf (a : Arg) : Except UnknownReason StructureKind :=
  match a with
  | .lit s => match StructureKind.ofString s with | some k => .ok k | none => .error (.malformed s!"region kind {s}")
  | .var v => .error (.malformed s!"region kind `{v}` is a variable")
  | .nat _ => .error (.malformed "region kind")
def deviceKindOf (a : Arg) : Except UnknownReason DeviceKind :=
  match a with
  | .lit s => match DeviceKind.ofString s with | some k => .ok k | none => .error (.malformed s!"device kind {s}")
  | .var v => .error (.malformed s!"device kind `{v}` is a variable")
  | .nat _ => .error (.malformed "device kind")

/-- φ where the precondition holds; undefined where it is false; the precondition's reasons where
    it is unknown. -/
def definedWhenR (pre x : R) : R :=
  match pre.v with
  | .t => x
  | .f => R.u (.undefined "defined_when")
  | .u => ⟨.u, pre.why⟩

/-- A selection at one instant: the branch the guard picks; where the guard is unknown, the
    branches' common value, else unknown with the guard's reasons. -/
def condAt (g : R) (a b : QR) : QR :=
  match g.v with
  | .t => a
  | .f => b
  | .u => match a, b with
    | .ok x, .ok y => if Q.eq x y then .ok x else .error (g.why.head?.getD (.malformed "cond"))
    | _, _ => .error (g.why.head?.getD (.malformed "cond"))

/-- An aggregate over the members present at one instant: unknown when a member's membership is
    unknown or a member's value is; `count` on an empty set is zero, the others are undefined. -/
def aggregateAt (op : AggOp) (xs : List (R × QR)) : QR :=
  match xs.find? (fun (f, _) => f.v == .u) with
  | some (f, _) => .error (f.why.head?.getD (.malformed "aggregate"))
  | none =>
    let vals := xs.filterMap fun (f, q) => if f.v == .t then some q else none
    match op with
    | .count => .ok (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat vals.length))
    | _ => do
      let qs ← vals.mapM fun q => q
      if qs.isEmpty then .error (.undefined "aggregate")
      else
        let sorted := qs.toArray.qsort (fun a b => Q.lt a b)
        match op with
        | .min => .ok sorted[0]!
        | .max => .ok sorted[sorted.size - 1]!
        | _ => .ok sorted[sorted.size / 2]!

/-- Membership of a road user in a legal aggregate at one scene: true when it carries an included
    class; unknown, with the observation's reason, when an included or unresolved class it might
    carry is unobserved; unknown as `aggregateUnresolved` when it carries a class the definition
    leaves unresolved; false otherwise. -/
def aggregateMembership (s : Scene) (t : TrackId) (a : LegalAggregate) : R :=
  let classes := fun (ids : List String) => ids.filterMap fun i => RoadUserClass.ofString (i.drop 3).toString
  match ru_aggregate s t (classes a.included) with
  | some true => R.t
  | none => R.u (.absentAtom "ru_aggregate")
  | some false =>
    match ru_aggregate s t (classes a.unresolved) with
    | some true => R.u (.aggregateUnresolved a.id)
    | some false => R.f
    | none => R.u (.absentAtom "ru_aggregate")

/-- Kleene aggregate at each instant over the evaluated members present in that scene. -/
def perScene (c : SemCtx) (evaluated : List (Nat × Array R))
    (presentIn : Scene → Nat → Bool) (agg : List R → R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range c.n).map fun i =>
    let s := c.scenes[i]!
    agg (evaluated.filterMap fun (m, arr) => if presentIn s m then some arr[i]! else none)

mutual
  def evalTAll (c : SemCtx) : Term → Array QR
    | .lit v _ => Array.replicate c.n (.ok v)
    | .param p => Array.replicate c.n (match c.d.ρ.param p with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.parameterMissing p))
    | .measure a args =>
      match resolveAll c.β args with
      | .error w => constE c.n w
      | .ok ds => c.scenes.map fun s => evalMeasure s a ds
    | .quantity concept args ps =>
      liftQ c.n do
        let vs ← constParams c ps
        Primitives.evalQ concept c.d (← resolveAll c.β args) vs
    | .distanceWhile subj φ =>
      match c.β.track subj with
      | none => constE c.n (.unboundVariable subj)
      | some x => Primitives.distanceWhile c.d x (evalAll c φ)
    | .sinceRise φ => sinceRiseAll c.d.times (evalAll c φ)
    | .headingSince subj g ψ =>
      match c.β.track subj with
      | none => constE c.n (.unboundVariable subj)
      | some x => liftQ c.n do
          let gv ← stepOf g (evalTAll c g)
          pure (Primitives.headingSince c.d x gv (evalAll c ψ))
    | .aggregate op v φ t =>
      let members := (usersOf c).map fun u =>
        let c' := c.bindVar v (.track u)
        (u, evalAll c' φ, evalTAll c' t)
      (Array.range c.n).map fun i =>
        let s := c.scenes[i]!
        aggregateAt op (members.filterMap fun (u, fa, ta) => if s.tracks.contains u then some (fa[i]!, ta[i]!) else none)
    | .add a b' => qzip Q.add (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
    | .sub a b' => qzip Q.sub (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
    | .mul a b' => qzip Q.mul (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
    | .div a b' => Array.zipWith (fun x y => do
        let d ← y
        if Q.isZero d then .error (.divisionByZero "div") else pure (Q.div (← x) d)) (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
    | .neg a => (evalTAll c a).map (·.map Q.neg)
    | .abs a => (evalTAll c a).map (·.map Q.abs)
    | .cond φ a b' =>
      let g := evalAll c φ; let x := evalTAll c a; let y := evalTAll c b'
      (Array.range c.n).map fun i => condAt (g[i]?.getD (R.u .outOfRange)) (x[i]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)) (y[i]?.getD (.error .outOfRange))
  termination_by t => sizeOf t

  /-- Parameters of an atom or derived concept: constant terms, evaluated once. -/
  def constParams (c : SemCtx) : List Term → Except UnknownReason (List Q)
    | [] => .ok []
    | t :: rest => do
      let v ← constOf t (evalTAll c t)
      pure (v :: (← constParams c rest))
  termination_by ts => sizeOf ts

  def evalAll (c : SemCtx) : Formula → Array R
    | .tt => const c.n R.t
    | .ff => const c.n R.f
    | .atom name args ps =>
      liftA c.n do
        let vs ← constParams c ps
        let ds ← resolveAll c.β args
        if name == "ru_aggregate" then
          pure (match ds with
            | [.v t, .s id] =>
              match c.d.aggregateOverrides.find? (fun (x, a, _) => x == t && a == id) with
              | some (_, _, v) => const c.n (R.ofBool v)
              | none =>
                match c.d.ρ.aggregate id with
                | none => const c.n (R.u (.parameterMissing s!"aggregate:{id}"))
                | some a => c.scenes.map fun s => aggregateMembership s t a
            | _ => const c.n (R.u (.malformed "aggregate arguments")))
        else pure (c.scenes.map fun s => match evalAtomE s name ds vs with | .ok r => r | .error w => R.u w)
    | .cmp l op r => Array.zipWith (fun x y => match x, y with
        | .ok a, .ok b => R.ofBool (op.apply a b)
        | .error w, _ | _, .error w => R.u w) (evalTAll c l) (evalTAll c r)
    | .asm id => c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (s.assumption id) (.assumptionMissing id)
    | .intent id who target =>
      match who, target with
      | .var a, .var b =>
        match c.β.lookup a, c.β.lookup b with
        | some (.track x), some (.region r) => c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (s.intention id x r) (.intentionMissing id)
        | none, _ => constU c.n (.unboundVariable a)
        | _, none => constU c.n (.unboundVariable b)
        | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "intent: a track and a region expected")
      | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "intent: a track and a region expected")
    | .same a b =>
      match resolve c.β a, resolve c.β b with
      | .ok (.v i), .ok (.v j) => const c.n (R.ofBool (i == j))
      | .error w, _ | _, .error w => constU c.n w
      | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "same: entities expected")
    | .not φ => mapNot (evalAll c φ)
    -- a connective whose left operand settles it at every instant does not evaluate its right one
    | .and φ ψ =>
      let a := evalAll c φ
      if a.all (·.v == .f) then a.map (fun _ => R.f) else zipAnd a (evalAll c ψ)
    | .or φ ψ =>
      let a := evalAll c φ
      if a.all (·.v == .t) then a.map (fun _ => R.t) else zipOr a (evalAll c ψ)
    | .implies φ ψ =>
      let a := evalAll c φ
      if a.all (·.v == .f) then a.map (fun _ => R.t) else zipImplies a (evalAll c ψ)
    | .always φ => alwaysAll (evalAll c φ)
    | .eventually φ => eventuallyAll (evalAll c φ)
    | .until φ ψ => untilAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ)
    | .since φ ψ => sinceAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ)
    | .holdsFor m d subj φ =>
      liftA c.n do
        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
        pure (holdsForAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "holdsFor" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ))
    | .within m d subj φ =>
      liftA c.n do
        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
        pure (withinAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "within" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ))
    | .untilWithin m d subj φ ψ =>
      liftA c.n do
        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
        pure (untilWithinAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "untilWithin" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ))
    | .atLast m d subj ψ φ =>
      liftA c.n do
        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
        pure (atLastAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "atLast" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c ψ) (evalAll c φ))
    | .count edge sinceφ op k =>
      (countEdgesAll "count" (evalAll c edge) (evalAll c sinceφ)).map fun e => match e with
        | .error w => R.u w
        | .ok m => R.ofBool (op.apply (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat m)) (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)))
    | .rises φ => risesAll (evalAll c φ)
    | .definedWhen pre φ => Array.zipWith definedWhenR (evalAll c pre) (evalAll c φ)
    | .derived concept args ps =>
      liftA c.n do
        let vs ← constParams c ps
        Primitives.evalB concept c.d (← resolveAll c.β args) vs
    | .rule id map =>
      let arr := c.compose id map c.β false
      if arr.size = c.n then arr else constU c.n (.compositionUnknown id)
    | .ruleApplies id map =>
      let arr := c.compose id map c.β true
      if arr.size = c.n then arr else constU c.n (.compositionUnknown id)
    | .existsUser v φ =>
      perScene c ((usersOf c).map fun t => (t, evalAll (c.bindVar v (.track t)) φ))
        (fun s t => s.tracks.contains t) R.any
    | .forallUser v φ =>
      perScene c ((usersOf c).map fun t => (t, evalAll (c.bindVar v (.track t)) φ))
        (fun s t => s.tracks.contains t) R.all
    | .existsRegion k v φ =>
      match regionKindOf k with
      | .error w => constU c.n w
      | .ok kd => perScene c ((regionsOf c kd).map fun r =>
            (r, Array.zipWith R.and (regionIsKind c r kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.region r)) φ)))
          (fun s r => (s.structure? r).isSome) R.any
    | .forallRegion k v φ =>
      match regionKindOf k with
      | .error w => constU c.n w
      | .ok kd => perScene c ((regionsOf c kd).map fun r =>
            (r, Array.zipWith R.implies (regionIsKind c r kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.region r)) φ)))
          (fun s r => (s.structure? r).isSome) R.all
    | .existsDevice k v φ =>
      match deviceKindOf k with
      | .error w => constU c.n w
      | .ok kd => perScene c ((devicesOf c kd).map fun d =>
            (d, Array.zipWith R.and (deviceIsKind c d kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.device d)) φ)))
          (fun s d => (s.device d).isSome) R.any
    | .forallDevice k v φ =>
      match deviceKindOf k with
      | .error w => constU c.n w
      | .ok kd => perScene c ((devicesOf c kd).map fun d =>
            (d, Array.zipWith R.implies (deviceIsKind c d kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.device d)) φ)))
          (fun s d => (s.device d).isSome) R.all
  termination_by φ => sizeOf φ
end

/-- The value of a formula at instant `i`. -/
def eval (c : SemCtx) (i : Nat) (φ : Formula) : R := (evalAll c φ)[i]?.getD (R.u .outOfRange)
def evalTri (c : SemCtx) (i : Nat) (φ : Formula) : Tri := (eval c i φ).v

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lengths: every formula and every term has exactly one value per observation of the trace.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section Lengths

private theorem n_bindVar (c : SemCtx) (v : String) (x : Val) : (c.bindVar v x).n = c.n := rfl
private theorem size_constU (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : (constU n w).size = n := by
  simp [constU, Temporal.size_const]
private theorem size_constE (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : (constE n w).size = n := by simp [constE]
private theorem size_liftA (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array R))
    (h : ∀ a, e = .ok a → a.size = n) : (liftA n e).size = n := by
  unfold liftA; cases e with
  | ok a => exact h a rfl
  | error w => exact size_constU n w
private theorem size_liftQ (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array QR))
    (h : ∀ a, e = .ok a → a.size = n) : (liftQ n e).size = n := by
  unfold liftQ; cases e with
  | ok a => exact h a rfl
  | error w => exact size_constE n w
private theorem size_qzip (f : Q → Q → Q) (a b : Array QR) : (qzip f a b).size = min a.size b.size := by
  simp [qzip]
private theorem size_perScene (c : SemCtx) (ev : List (Nat × Array R)) (p : Scene → Nat → Bool)
    (agg : List R → R) : (perScene c ev p agg).size = c.n := by simp [perScene]

mutual
  theorem size_evalTAll (c : SemCtx) : ∀ t : Term, (evalTAll c t).size = c.n
    | .lit _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
    | .param _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
    | .measure _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; split <;> simp [size_constE, SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
    | .quantity _ args ps => by
        rw [evalTAll]; apply size_liftQ; intro a h
        cases hv : constParams c ps <;> cases hr : resolveAll c.β args <;>
          simp only [hv, hr, bind, Except.bind] at h <;> try contradiction
        exact Primitives.size_evalQ _ _ _ _ _ h
    | .distanceWhile s φ => by
        rw [evalTAll]; split
        · exact size_constE _ _
        · rw [Primitives.size_distanceWhile]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .sinceRise φ => by rw [evalTAll, Temporal.size_sinceRiseAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => by
        rw [evalTAll]; split
        · exact size_constE _ _
        · apply size_liftQ; intro a h
          cases hg : stepOf g (evalTAll c g) <;> simp only [hg, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;>
            try contradiction
          cases h; rw [Primitives.size_headingSince]; exact size_evalAll c ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
    | .add a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
    | .sub a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
    | .mul a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
    | .div a b => by rw [evalTAll, Array.size_zipWith, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
    | .neg a => by rw [evalTAll, Array.size_map]; exact size_evalTAll c a
    | .abs a => by rw [evalTAll, Array.size_map]; exact size_evalTAll c a
    | .cond _ _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
  termination_by t => sizeOf t

  theorem size_evalAll (c : SemCtx) : ∀ φ : Formula, (evalAll c φ).size = c.n
    | .tt => by rw [evalAll]; exact Temporal.size_const _ _
    | .ff => by rw [evalAll]; exact Temporal.size_const _ _
    | .atom name args ps => by
        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
        cases hv : constParams c ps <;> cases hr : resolveAll c.β args <;>
          simp only [hv, hr, bind, Except.bind] at h <;> try contradiction
        split at h
        · cases h; split
          · split
            · exact Temporal.size_const _ _
            · split
              · exact Temporal.size_const _ _
              · simp [SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
          · exact Temporal.size_const _ _
        · cases h; simp [SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
    | .cmp l _ r => by rw [evalAll, Array.size_zipWith, size_evalTAll c l, size_evalTAll c r, Nat.min_self]
    | .asm _ => by rw [evalAll]; simp [SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
    | .intent _ who target => by
        cases who <;> cases target <;> rw [evalAll] <;> (repeat' split) <;>
          simp [size_constU, SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
    | .same a b => by
        rw [evalAll]; split <;> simp [size_constU, Temporal.size_const]
    | .not φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_mapNot]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .and φ ψ => by
        rw [evalAll]; split
        · rw [Array.size_map]; exact size_evalAll c φ
        · rw [Temporal.size_zipAnd, size_evalAll c φ, size_evalAll c ψ, Nat.min_self]
    | .or φ ψ => by
        rw [evalAll]; split
        · rw [Array.size_map]; exact size_evalAll c φ
        · rw [Temporal.size_zipOr, size_evalAll c φ, size_evalAll c ψ, Nat.min_self]
    | .implies φ ψ => by
        rw [evalAll]; split
        · rw [Array.size_map]; exact size_evalAll c φ
        · rw [Temporal.size_zipImplies, size_evalAll c φ, size_evalAll c ψ, Nat.min_self]
    | .always φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_alwaysAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .eventually φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_eventuallyAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .until φ ψ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_untilAll]; exact size_evalAll c ψ
    | .since φ ψ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_sinceAll]; exact size_evalAll c ψ
    | .holdsFor m d s φ => by
        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>
          simp only [hx, hd, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;> try contradiction
        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_holdsForAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .within m d s φ => by
        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>
          simp only [hx, hd, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;> try contradiction
        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_withinAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => by
        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>
          simp only [hx, hd, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;> try contradiction
        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_untilWithinAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .atLast m d s ψ φ => by
        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>
          simp only [hx, hd, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;> try contradiction
        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_atLastAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .count edge sφ _ _ => by rw [evalAll, Array.size_map, Temporal.size_countEdgesAll]; exact size_evalAll c edge
    | .rises φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_risesAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .definedWhen pre φ => by rw [evalAll, Array.size_zipWith, size_evalAll c pre, size_evalAll c φ, Nat.min_self]
    | .derived _ args ps => by
        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
        cases hv : constParams c ps <;> cases hr : resolveAll c.β args <;>
          simp only [hv, hr, bind, Except.bind] at h <;> try contradiction
        exact Primitives.size_evalB _ _ _ _ _ h
    | .rule _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split <;> simp_all [size_constU]
    | .ruleApplies _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split <;> simp_all [size_constU]
    | .existsUser _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
    | .forallUser _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
    | .existsRegion _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
    | .forallRegion _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
    | .existsDevice _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
    | .forallDevice _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
  termination_by φ => sizeOf φ
end

end Lengths

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Unfolding lemmas: the connectives are the pointwise three-valued operations of Unknown.lean.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section Lemmas
variable (c : SemCtx) (φ ψ : Formula)

theorem evalAll_tt : evalAll c .tt = const c.n R.t := by rw [evalAll]
theorem evalAll_ff : evalAll c .ff = const c.n R.f := by rw [evalAll]
theorem evalAll_not : evalAll c (.not φ) = (evalAll c φ).map R.not := by rw [evalAll]; rfl
private theorem and_of_f (a b : R) (h : a.v = .f) : R.and a b = R.f := by
  rcases a with ⟨av, aw⟩; subst h; simp [R.and, R.settle, Tri.and, R.f]
private theorem or_of_t (a b : R) (h : a.v = .t) : R.or a b = R.t := by
  rcases a with ⟨av, aw⟩; subst h; simp [R.or, R.settle, Tri.or, R.t]
private theorem implies_of_f (a b : R) (h : a.v = .f) : R.implies a b = R.t := by
  rcases a with ⟨av, aw⟩; subst h; simp [R.implies, R.not, R.or, R.settle, Tri.not, Tri.or, R.t]

/-- A connective is the pointwise three-valued operation of its operands' arrays, whether or not
    its right operand was evaluated: where the left one settles it at every instant, both arrays
    have one value per observation and every pointwise value is the settled one. -/
theorem evalAll_and : evalAll c (.and φ ψ) = Array.zipWith R.and (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by
  rw [evalAll]; split
  · rename_i h
    rw [Array.all_eq_true] at h
    apply Array.ext
    · simp [size_evalAll]
    · intro i h1 h2
      simp only [Array.getElem_map, Array.getElem_zipWith]
      rw [and_of_f _ _ (by simpa using h i (by simpa using h1))]
  · rfl
theorem evalAll_or : evalAll c (.or φ ψ) = Array.zipWith R.or (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by
  rw [evalAll]; split
  · rename_i h
    rw [Array.all_eq_true] at h
    apply Array.ext
    · simp [size_evalAll]
    · intro i h1 h2
      simp only [Array.getElem_map, Array.getElem_zipWith]
      rw [or_of_t _ _ (by simpa using h i (by simpa using h1))]
  · rfl
theorem evalAll_implies : evalAll c (.implies φ ψ) = Array.zipWith R.implies (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by
  rw [evalAll]; split
  · rename_i h
    rw [Array.all_eq_true] at h
    apply Array.ext
    · simp [size_evalAll]
    · intro i h1 h2
      simp only [Array.getElem_map, Array.getElem_zipWith]
      rw [implies_of_f _ _ (by simpa using h i (by simpa using h1))]
  · rfl
theorem evalAll_always : evalAll c (.always φ) = alwaysAll (evalAll c φ) := by rw [evalAll]
theorem evalAll_eventually : evalAll c (.eventually φ) = eventuallyAll (evalAll c φ) := by rw [evalAll]
theorem evalAll_until : evalAll c (.until φ ψ) = untilAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by rw [evalAll]
theorem evalAll_since : evalAll c (.since φ ψ) = sinceAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by rw [evalAll]
theorem evalAll_rule (id : String) (map : List (String × String)) (h : (c.compose id map c.β false).size = c.n) :
    evalAll c (.rule id map) = c.compose id map c.β false := by rw [evalAll]; simp [h]
theorem evalAll_ruleApplies (id : String) (map : List (String × String)) (h : (c.compose id map c.β true).size = c.n) :
    evalAll c (.ruleApplies id map) = c.compose id map c.β true := by rw [evalAll]; simp [h]

/-- The heading-change term is the accumulation operator over its onset's values. -/
theorem evalTAll_headingSince (s : String) (g : Term) (x : TrackId) (gv : Q)
    (hx : c.β.track s = some x) (hg : stepOf g (evalTAll c g) = .ok gv) :
    evalTAll c (.headingSince s g ψ) = Primitives.headingSince c.d x gv (evalAll c ψ) := by
  rw [evalTAll]; simp only [hx, hg, liftQ, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure]
/-- Unknown is absorbing for `not`, pointwise. -/
theorem eval_not_u (i : Nat) (h : (eval c i φ).v = .u) (hi : i < (evalAll c φ).size) : (eval c i (.not φ)).v = .u := by
  unfold eval at *
  rw [evalAll_not, Array.getElem?_map]
  simp only [Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some, R.not_v] at *
  rw [h]; rfl
end Lemmas

end Semantics
end TrafficSpec

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.RuleEval
  Evaluating a rule over a trace, and checking it before any trace.

  `verdicts` combines the binder classes, the applicability and the obligation per instant
  (Kleene, `verdictAt`). `check` finds from the syntax every defect the evaluator would otherwise
  report as `malformed` or `unboundVariable`; its doc comment lists them. `checkReading`
  names the parameters and aggregates the reading lacks, over the rule and the rules it composes,
  with their concept calls expanded; `Concept.checkReading` the aggregates a concept's body names.

  `Concept.check` holds a concept to the same standard on every admissible instantiation of
  its formals, with its calls expanded. `Concept.callDefects` holds every concept call to the
  callee's signature before expansion loses it.

  Nothing under Rules/ or Concepts/ imports this file; Grounding, Manifest and Monitor do.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Concept
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Semantics
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.EvalFast

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Rule
open Semantics

/-- A rule's formula as evaluated: every comparison over a `cond` decided by cases, through the
    sub-expression cache (`evalFastAll`, whose every stored value is the one `evalAll` gives). -/
def evalRuleFormula (c : SemCtx) (φ : Formula) : Array R := evalFastAll c (Formula.elimCond φ)

/-- Every binder's class holds for its bound track and the applicability holds, per instant. -/
def engagedAll (r : Rule) (c : SemCtx) : Array R :=
  Temporal.allOf c.n (r.binders.map (fun b => evalRuleFormula c b.cls) ++ [evalRuleFormula c r.applicability])

/-- The verdict at every instant. -/
def verdicts (r : Rule) (c : SemCtx) : Array Verdict :=
  Array.zipWith verdictAt (r.engagedAll c) (evalRuleFormula c r.obligation)

/-- The rule as a three-valued statement per instant: complied with (true), violated (false), or
    unknown. Not engaged counts as complied with — a rule that does not apply is not broken. -/
def asRAll (r : Rule) (c : SemCtx) : Array R :=
  (r.verdicts c).map fun v => match v with
    | .compliant | .notApplicable => R.t
    | .violated => R.f
    | .unknown w => ⟨.u, w⟩

/-- Structural well-formedness apart from having a binder: binders named and distinct, the id
    set, every assumption and intention used declared, every intention id well-formed, every
    operationalization bounding its standard by atoms, primitives or concepts. -/
def wellFormedBody (r : Rule) : Bool :=
  r.binderNames.eraseDups.length == r.binders.length &&
  r.binders.all (fun b => !b.name.isEmpty) &&
  !r.id.isEmpty &&
  r.usedAssumptions.all (r.assumptions.contains ·) &&
  r.usedIntentions.all (r.intentions.contains ·) &&
  r.intentions.all IntId.wellFormed &&
  r.operationalizations.all (fun o => !o.concepts.isEmpty && o.concepts.all fun c =>
    c.startsWith "drv." || Primitives.primitiveNames.contains (defName c) || knowsAtom (defName c))

/-- Structural well-formedness: at least one binder, and `wellFormedBody`. -/
def wellFormed (r : Rule) : Bool := !r.binders.isEmpty && r.wellFormedBody

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Static check
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Variables in scope with their sorts, the innermost first. -/
abbrev Scope := List (String × EntityKind)

/-- Whether `v` is bound and its innermost binding has sort `k`, as evaluation's lookup reads it. -/
def Scope.binds (scope : Scope) (v : String) (k : EntityKind) : Bool :=
  (scope.find? (·.1 == v)).map (·.2) == some k

/-- Resolve arguments against the scope with dummy ids, checking each variable's sort against the
    position's expected sort when the table knows it. An entity position takes a variable only:
    a literal or a number there would name a track, region or device the rule has no right to. -/
private def dummyArgs (scope : Scope) (sorts : Option (List (Option EntityKind))) (args : List Arg)
    : Except String (List Primitives.DArg) :=
  (args.zip (List.range args.length)).mapM fun (a, k) =>
    match a with
    | .var v =>
      match scope.find? (·.1 == v) with
      | none => .error s!"variable `{v}` is not bound"
      | some (_, vs) =>
        match sorts.bind (·[k]?) with
        | some (some want) => if want == vs then .ok (.v 0) else .error s!"variable `{v}` has sort {repr vs}, position {k} wants {repr want}"
        | some none => .error s!"variable `{v}` where position {k} takes a literal"
        | none => .ok (.v 0)
    | .lit l =>
      match sorts.bind (·[k]?) with
      | some (some want) => .error s!"literal `{l}` where position {k} wants a {repr want}"
      | _ => .ok (.s l)
    | .nat n =>
      match sorts.bind (·[k]?) with
      | some (some want) => .error s!"number `{n}` where position {k} wants a {repr want}"
      | _ => .ok (.n n)

private def isMalformed : UnknownReason → Option String
  | .malformed w => some w
  | .parameterMissing w => some w
  | _ => none

private def emptyScene : Scene := { t := 0 }
private def emptyCtx : Primitives.Ctx := { scenes := #[], times := #[], ρ := {} }

/-- A quantifier's kind: a spelling the codec decodes. A variable is a concept's literal formal
    that reached the check unfilled. -/
private def kindErrors (where_ : String) (a : Arg) (what : String) (known : String → Bool) : List String :=
  match a with
  | .lit s => if known s then [] else [s!"{where_}: {what} kind `{s}` names no kind"]
  | .var v => [s!"{where_}: {what} kind `{v}` is a variable; spell the kind, or fill it from a literal formal"]
  | .nat _ => [s!"{where_}: {what} kind is a number"]

private def constParamErrors (where_ name : String) (ps : List Term) : List String :=
  ps.filter (!Term.isConstant ·) |>.map fun _ => s!"{where_}: `{name}` parameter is not a constant term"

/-- A heading change's step bound: a literal or a reading parameter, a literal strictly positive. -/
private def stepErrors (where_ : String) : Term → List String
  | .lit q _ => if Q.lt Q.zero q then [] else [s!"{where_}: heading_since step bound is not strictly positive"]
  | .param _ => []
  | _ => [s!"{where_}: heading_since step bound is not a literal or a reading parameter"]

mutual
  partial def checkTerm (scope : Scope) (where_ : String) : Term → List String
    | .lit _ _ | .param _ => []
    | .measure a args =>
      match dummyArgs scope (atomArgSorts a) args with
      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"]
      | .ok ds => match evalMeasure emptyScene a ds with
        | .error w => match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: measure `{a}`: {m}"] | none => []
        | .ok _ => []
    | .quantity concept args ps =>
      let inner := ps.flatMap (checkTerm scope where_) ++ constParamErrors where_ concept ps
      match dummyArgs scope (Primitives.argSorts concept) args with
      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"] ++ inner
      | .ok ds => match Primitives.evalQ concept emptyCtx ds (ps.map fun _ => Q.zero) with
        | .error w => (match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: `{concept}`: {m}"] | none => []) ++ inner
        | .ok _ => inner
    | .distanceWhile subj φ =>
      (if scope.binds subj .track then [] else [s!"{where_}: subject `{subj}` is not a bound track"]) ++
      checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .sinceRise φ => checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .headingSince subj g ψ =>
      (if scope.binds subj .track then [] else [s!"{where_}: subject `{subj}` is not a bound track"]) ++
      stepErrors where_ g ++ checkTerm scope where_ g ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ
    | .aggregate _ v φ t => checkFormula ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ φ ++ checkTerm ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => checkTerm scope where_ a ++ checkTerm scope where_ b
    | .neg a | .abs a => checkTerm scope where_ a
    | .cond φ a b => checkFormula scope where_ φ ++ checkTerm scope where_ a ++ checkTerm scope where_ b

  partial def checkFormula (scope : Scope) (where_ : String) : Formula → List String
    | .tt | .ff | .asm _ => []
    | .intent _ who target =>
      [(who, EntityKind.track, "road user"), (target, EntityKind.region, "region")].flatMap fun (a, want, what) =>
        match a with
        | .var v => if scope.binds v want then [] else [s!"{where_}: intent's {what} `{v}` is not a bound {repr want}"]
        | _ => [s!"{where_}: intent's {what} is a variable"]
    | .same a b => [a, b].flatMap fun arg => match arg with
      | .var v => if scope.any (·.1 == v) then [] else [s!"{where_}: variable `{v}` is not bound"]
      | _ => [s!"{where_}: `same` compares two bound variables"]
    | .atom name args ps =>
      let inner := ps.flatMap (checkTerm scope where_) ++ constParamErrors where_ name ps
      match dummyArgs scope (atomArgSorts name) args with
      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"] ++ inner
      | .ok ds =>
        if name == "ru_aggregate" then inner     -- membership is the reading's; `checkReading` holds the word
        else match evalAtomE emptyScene name ds (ps.map fun _ => Q.zero) with
        | .error w => (match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: atom `{name}`: {m}"] | none => []) ++ inner
        | .ok _ => inner
    | .cmp l _ r => checkTerm scope where_ l ++ checkTerm scope where_ r
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ => checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ => checkFormula scope where_ φ ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ
    | .holdsFor m d subj φ | .within m d subj φ =>
      windowErrors scope where_ m d subj ++ checkTerm scope where_ d ++ checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .untilWithin m d subj φ ψ =>
      windowErrors scope where_ m d subj ++ checkTerm scope where_ d ++ checkFormula scope where_ φ ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ
    | .atLast m d subj ψ φ =>
      windowErrors scope where_ m d subj ++ checkTerm scope where_ d ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ ++ checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .count e sφ _ _ => checkFormula scope where_ e ++ checkFormula scope where_ sφ
    | .rises φ => checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .definedWhen p φ => checkFormula scope where_ p ++ checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .derived concept args ps =>
      let inner := ps.flatMap (checkTerm scope where_) ++ constParamErrors where_ concept ps
      match dummyArgs scope (Primitives.argSorts concept) args with
      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"] ++ inner
      | .ok ds => match Primitives.evalB concept emptyCtx ds (ps.map fun _ => Q.zero) with
        | .error w => (match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: `{concept}`: {m}"] | none => []) ++ inner
        | .ok _ => inner
    | .rule _ map | .ruleApplies _ map => map.flatMap fun (_, outer) =>
        if scope.binds outer .track then [] else [s!"{where_}: composition maps to `{outer}`, not a bound track"]
    | .existsRegion k v φ | .forallRegion k v φ =>
      kindErrors where_ k "region" (fun s => (StructureKind.ofString s).isSome) ++ checkFormula ((v, .region) :: scope) where_ φ
    | .existsDevice k v φ | .forallDevice k v φ =>
      kindErrors where_ k "device" (fun s => (DeviceKind.ofString s).isSome) ++ checkFormula ((v, .device) :: scope) where_ φ
    | .existsUser v φ | .forallUser v φ => checkFormula ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ φ

  partial def windowErrors (scope : Scope) (where_ : String) (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subj : String) : List String :=
    (if m = .path && !scope.binds subj .track then [s!"{where_}: window subject `{subj}` is not a bound track"] else []) ++
    (if Term.isConstant d then [] else [s!"{where_}: window length is not a constant term"])
end

import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Temporal

def const (n : Nat) (r : R) : Array R := Array.replicate n r

def zipAnd (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.and a b
def zipOr (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.or a b
def zipImplies (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.implies a b
def mapNot (a : Array R) : Array R := a.map R.not
def allOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipAnd (const n R.t)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Unbounded operators: one backward or forward pass with the unobserved tail as unknown.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n tail, tail)).1

private def forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n head, head)).1

/-- `always φ`: φ here and at every later observation, and the unobserved future. -/

/-- `eventually φ`: φ here or later, or the unobserved future. -/
def eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "eventually") R.or φ
/-- Strong until: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ until')`, the unobserved future as the tail. -/
def untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := ψ.size
  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "until"), truncated "until")).1
/-- Since: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ since')`, the unobserved past as the head. -/
def sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := ψ.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)

    adequately sampled. -/

  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d

/-- Distance from a point to a segment. -/
def segmentDistance (p a b : Vec) : Q :=
  let ab := vsub b a
  let ap := vsub p a
  let l2 := normSq ab
  if Q.isZero l2 then norm ap
  else
    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot ap ab) l2))
    norm (vsub p (vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)))
/-- Whether a point lies inside a polygon (ray casting), for footprint-in-region tests. -/
def inPolygon (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  let n := poly.length
  if n < 3 then false
  else
    let edges := (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
    let crossings := edges.filter fun (a, b) =>
      let (ax, ay) := a; let (bx, by_) := b
      ((Q.le ay p.2) != (Q.le by_ p.2)) &&
        -- x-intersection of the edge with the horizontal line through p, compared with p.x
        (let dy := Q.sub by_ ay
         !Q.isZero dy &&
         Q.lt p.1 (Q.add ax (Q.div (Q.mul (Q.sub p.2 ay) (Q.sub bx ax)) dy)))
    crossings.length % 2 == 1
/-- The sign of `(b − a) × (c − a)`: 1 when `c` is to the left of `ab`, −1 to its right, 0 on its line. -/
def orient (a b c : Vec) : Int :=
  let k := (cross (vsub b a) (vsub c a)).num
  if k > 0 then 1 else if k < 0 then -1 else 0
/-- Whether `p` lies on the closed segment `ab`, given that it lies on its line. -/
def withinBox (p a b : Vec) : Bool :=
  Q.le (Q.min a.1 b.1) p.1 && Q.le p.1 (Q.max a.1 b.1) && Q.le (Q.min a.2 b.2) p.2 && Q.le p.2 (Q.max a.2 b.2)
/-- Whether the closed segments `ab` and `cd` share a point, touching and collinear overlap included. -/
def segmentsIntersect (a b c d : Vec) : Bool :=
  let o1 := orient a b c; let o2 := orient a b d; let o3 := orient c d a; let o4 := orient c d b
  (o1 * o2 < 0 && o3 * o4 < 0) || (o1 == 0 && withinBox c a b) || (o2 == 0 && withinBox d a b)
    || (o3 == 0 && withinBox a c d) || (o4 == 0 && withinBox b c d)
/-- The edges of a polygon, the last vertex closing to the first. -/
def edges (poly : List Vec) : List (Vec × Vec) :=
  let n := poly.length
  (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
/-- Whether two polygons share a point as closed sets: an edge of one meets an edge of the other
    (touching counts), or one lies inside the other. Exact. -/
def polygonsOverlap (p q : List Vec) : Bool :=
  (edges p).any (fun (a, b) => (edges q).any fun (c, d) => segmentsIntersect a b c d)
    || p.any (inPolygon · q) || q.any (inPolygon · p)
/-- Distance from a point to a polygon's boundary: zero inside, the nearest edge outside. -/
def polygonDistance (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Q :=
  match poly with
  | [] => none
  | [a] => some (norm (vsub p a))
  | _ =>
    if inPolygon p poly then some Q.zero
    else
      let n := poly.length
      let ds := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentDistance p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
/-- The point of a segment nearest a point. -/
def segmentNearest (p a b : Vec) : Vec :=
  let ab := vsub b a
  let l2 := normSq ab
  if Q.isZero l2 then a
  else
    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot (vsub p a) ab) l2))
    vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)
/-- The point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point. -/
def nearestPoint (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
  match poly with
  | [] => none
  | [a] => some a
  | _ =>
    let n := poly.length
    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
    cs.foldl (fun acc c => match acc with
      | none => some c
      | some b => if Q.lt (normSq (vsub p c)) (normSq (vsub p b)) then some c else some b) none
/-- Every point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point: the nearest point of each edge whose
    distance is the least, so a tie keeps every equally near point whatever the vertex order. -/
def nearestPoints (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Vec :=
  match poly with
  | [] => []
  | [a] => [a]
  | _ =>
    let n := poly.length
    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
    match cs.map fun c => normSq (vsub p c) with
    | [] => []
    | d :: ds =>
      let m := ds.foldl Q.min d
      cs.filter fun c => Q.eq (normSq (vsub p c)) m

  No camera sees an intention. It reaches a rule through this one door, three-valued and per

import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.World

/-- Well-formed intention id: `int.` followed by a snake-case name. -/
def IntId.wellFormed (id : IntId) : Bool :=
  let rest := (id.drop 4).toString
  id.startsWith "int." && !rest.isEmpty && rest.all (fun c => c.isLower || c.isDigit || c == '_')

150	/-- The vector from the nearest point of polygon `p` to the nearest point of polygon `q`: zero when
151	    they share a point (`polygonsOverlap`), otherwise the shortest vector joining a vertex of one to
152	    the nearest point of the other's boundary, which for two convex polygons is the same for every
153	    nearest pair. `none` for an empty polygon. -/
154	def nearestOffset (p q : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
155	  if polygonsOverlap p q then some (Q.zero, Q.zero)
156	  else
157	    let fromP := p.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c q).map (vsub · c)
158	    let fromQ := q.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c p).map (vsub c ·)
159	    (fromP ++ fromQ).foldl (fun acc d => match acc with
160	      | none => some d
161	      | some e => if Q.lt (normSq d) (normSq e) then some d else some e) none
162	/-- The interval a polygon covers along the direction `u`, measured from `o`: (lowest, highest). -/
163	def span (u o : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option (Q × Q) :=
164	  match poly.map fun c => dot u (vsub c o) with
165	  | [] => none
166	  | x :: xs => some (xs.foldl Q.min x, xs.foldl Q.max x)
167	/-- Twice the signed area of a polygon (the shoelace sum). -/
168	def area2 (poly : List Vec) : Q :=
169	  (edges poly).foldl (fun acc (a, b) => Q.add acc (cross a b)) Q.zero
170	/-- Whether a polygon's boundary crosses or touches itself: two edges that are not neighbours
171	    meet, or two neighbouring edges fold back along one line. -/
172	def selfIntersects (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
173	  let es := (edges poly).toArray
174	  let n := es.size
175	  (List.range n).any fun i => (List.range n).any fun j =>
176	    if j ≤ i then false
177	    else
178	      let (a, b) := es[i]!
179	      let (c, d) := es[j]!
180	      if j == i + 1 then orient a b d == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub b a) (vsub d c)) Q.zero
181	      else if i == 0 && j + 1 == n then orient c d b == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub d c) (vsub b a)) Q.zero
182	      else segmentsIntersect a b c d
183	/-- A simple polygon: at least three vertices, a non-zero area, and a boundary that neither crosses
184	    nor touches itself (a repeated vertex makes two edges that are not neighbours meet). -/
185	def simplePolygon (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
186	  poly.length ≥ 3 && !Q.isZero (area2 poly) && !selfIntersects poly
187	/-- Whether a point lies on a polygon's boundary. Exact. -/
188	def onBoundary (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
189	  (edges poly).any fun (a, b) => orient a b p == 0 && withinBox p a b
190	/-- The parameters `t` at which the line `p + t·u` meets the polygon's boundary: one per edge it
191	    crosses or touches, and both ends of an edge it runs along. `u` is not the zero vector. -/
192	def lineCrossings (p u : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Q :=
193	  (edges poly).flatMap fun (a, b) =>
194	    let d := vsub b a
195	    let w := vsub a p
196	    let den := cross u d
197	    if Q.isZero den then
198	      if Q.isZero (cross u w) then [Q.div (dot w u) (dot u u), Q.div (dot (vsub b p) u) (dot u u)] else []
199	    else
200	      let s := Q.div (cross w u) den
201	      if Q.le Q.zero s && Q.le s (Q.ofInt 1) then [Q.div (cross w d) den] else []
202	end Geom

280	/-- Whether a source that cannot tell kind `m` (it is among `unobservedKinds`) leaves this structure's
281	    membership of `m`'s kinds open: always where `m` refines no kind other than an abstract one;
282	    otherwise only where the structure is labelled `m` or a kind `m` refines, since a structure of any
283	    other kind is known not to be one. -/
284	def Structure.maskApplies (st : Structure) (m : StructureKind) : Bool :=
285	  (m.parent?.filter (!·.isAbstract)).isNone || m.refines st.kind

287	/-- Whether a structure is of kind `k`: unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
288	    structure, is `k` or a kind `k` refines (the label cannot be trusted for `k`); true where the
289	    structure's kind refines `k`; unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
290	    structure, refines `k`; false otherwise. A parent never implies a kind refining it, two kinds
291	    refining one parent never imply each other, and a kind the source cannot tell never makes a known
292	    parent unknown. An abstract kind is the union of the kinds refining it: true where the structure
293	    is of one of them, unknown where it is of none and unknown for one, false otherwise. -/

297	    if masked.any (k.refines ·) then none
298	    else if st.kind.refines k then some true
299	    else if masked.any (·.refines k) then none
300	    else some false
301	  if k.isAbstract then
302	    let vs := (StructureKind.all.filter (·.parent? == some k)).map concrete
303	    if vs.contains (some true) then some true else if vs.contains none then none else some false

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Environment
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def env_darkness (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.darkness
def env_precipitation (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.precipitation
def env_wet_road (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.wetRoad
def env_ice_or_snow (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.iceOrSnow
def env_visibility (s : Scene) : Option Q := s.env.visibility
def env_civil_time (s : Scene) : Option CivilTime := s.env.civilTime

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Relations between road users. Measured where the source supplies them, otherwise computed
-- from kinematics. `none` when a needed kinematic is missing.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def rel_centre_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.centreDistance) with
  | some d => some d
  | none => do
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let pb ← kin_position s b
    pure (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub pb pa))

/-- Components of `b`'s position relative to `a` in `a`'s heading frame (longitudinal, lateral). -/
private def relFrame (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) := do
  let pa ← kin_position s a
  let pb ← kin_position s b
  let ha ← kin_heading s a
  Geom.inFrame ha (Geom.vsub pb pa)

/-- The gap between the two bodies: the vector from the nearest point of `a`'s footprint to the
    nearest point of `b`'s, each footprint read with its own heading and extent, given as its
    lengths along and across `a`'s heading (longitudinal, lateral). Neither is ever negative; both
    are zero exactly when the footprints touch or overlap. `none` when either footprint is not
    observed, and when a supplied gap has a negative component. -/
def rel_surface_gap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.surfaceGap) with
  | some g => if Q.isNonneg g.1 && Q.isNonneg g.2 then some g else none
  | none => do
    let fa ← footprint s a
    let fb ← footprint s b
    let d ← Geom.nearestOffset fa fb
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let (lon, lat) ← Geom.inFrame ha d
    pure (Q.abs lon, Q.abs lat)
def rel_surface_gap_longitudinal (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.1)
def rel_surface_gap_lateral (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.2)
/-- The distance between the nearest points of the two bodies, the gap's length: zero on contact
    or overlap, never negative. -/
def rel_surface_gap_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map Geom.norm

/-- `a` and `b` share a lane and `a` is ahead of `b` along `a`'s heading. The lane is any region both
    occupy that is of kind lane (`Structure.isOfKind`): unknown when `a` is ahead and no shared region
    is known to be a lane but one may be. -/
def rel_ahead_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.aAheadOfB) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ra ← rel_occupies_regions s a
    let rb ← rel_occupies_regions s b
    let (lon, _) ← relFrame s a b
    if !Q.lt lon Q.zero then some false
    else
      let shared := (s.structures.filter fun st => ra.contains st.id && rb.contains st.id).map (·.isOfKind .lane)
      if shared.contains (some true) then some true
      else if shared.contains none then none
      else some false
def rel_ahead_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s a b
def rel_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s b a

/-- Signed overlap of the two footprints along `a`'s heading, each read with its own heading and
    extent: the length their projections on that axis share, positive when the bodies are side by
    side, otherwise the gap between the projections negated. A projection: it reads nothing across
    the axis, so a positive value is no contact and a negative one no distance between the bodies. -/
def rel_longitudinal_overlap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.longitudinalOverlap) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let u ← Geom.unit ha
    let fa ← footprint s a
    let fb ← footprint s b
    let (loA, hiA) ← Geom.span u pa fa
    let (loB, hiB) ← Geom.span u pa fb
    pure (Q.sub (Q.min hiA hiB) (Q.max loA loB))

/-- Headings opposed (cosine below `-cosTol`) and the distance decreasing. -/
def rel_oncoming (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.oncoming) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let hb ← kin_heading s b
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let pb ← kin_position s b
    let va ← kin_velocity s a
    let vb ← kin_velocity s b
    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
    let closing := Q.lt (Geom.dot (Geom.vsub pb pa) (Geom.vsub vb va)) Q.zero
    pure (Q.lt (Geom.dot ua ub) (Q.neg cosTol) && closing)

/-- Headings aligned (cosine above `cosTol`). -/
def rel_same_direction (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.sameDirection) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let hb ← kin_heading s b
    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
    pure (Q.gt (Geom.dot ua ub) cosTol)

/-- `b` relative to `a` in `a`'s frame: (longitudinal, lateral), lateral positive to the left. -/
def rel_bearing (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Vec :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.bearing) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => relFrame s a b
def rel_bearing_right (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.2 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_left (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.2 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_ahead (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.1 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_behind (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.1 Q.zero

/-- The bodies touch or overlap. -/
def rel_contact (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.contact) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => (rel_surface_gap s a b).map fun g => Q.le g.1 Q.zero && Q.le g.2 Q.zero

/-- `b` is in `a`'s line of sight, as the source tested it; never computed. -/
def rel_visible (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.relation a b).bind (·.visible)

end TrafficSpec

28	    numerator and denominator. -/
29	def sameBoundary : List Vec → List Vec → Bool
30	  | [], [] => true

/-

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Primitives
  What the formula language cannot express, each a geometric computation with no legal word in it:
  a heading change integrated over a window, the closest approach of two bodies under constant
  velocities, the structured matching of a sign's legend. One definition per `prim.*` id of the
  ontology, named `prim_name`, computed over the whole trace from atoms only, parameters as
  arguments with no default.

  A concept (a pipeline node) is written over atoms and primitives in the formula language and
  expanded before evaluation; nothing else computes a manoeuvre here. `Ctx` is the trace indexed
  for evaluation, shared with Semantics.lean.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.RegionTable
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Params
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Accumulate

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Primitives
open Temporal

/-- Whether two boundaries are the same list of vertices, each coordinate compared by its
    numerator and denominator. -/
def sameBoundary : List Vec → List Vec → Bool
  | [], [] => true
  | a :: as, b :: bs =>
    a.1.num == b.1.num && a.1.den == b.1.den && a.2.num == b.2.num && a.2.den == b.2.den && sameBoundary as bs
  | _, _ => false

theorem sameBoundary_eq : ∀ {a b : List Vec}, sameBoundary a b = true → a = b
  | [], [], _ => rfl
  | a :: as, b :: bs, h => by
    simp only [sameBoundary, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at h
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, h4⟩, h5⟩ := h
    rcases a with ⟨⟨an1, ad1, _⟩, ⟨an2, ad2, _⟩⟩
    rcases b with ⟨⟨bn1, bd1, _⟩, ⟨bn2, bd2, _⟩⟩
    simp only at h1 h2 h3 h4
    subst h1 h2 h3 h4
    rw [sameBoundary_eq h5]
  | [], _ :: _, h => by simp [sameBoundary] at h
  | _ :: _, [], h => by simp [sameBoundary] at h

/-- A region's boundary with its simple-polygon flag, computed the first time it is read; the flag
    is the direct check of that boundary by construction. -/
structure SimpleEntry where
  id : RegionId
  boundary : List Vec
  flag : Thunk Bool
  ok : flag.get = Geom.simplePolygon boundary

/-- One entry per region and distinct boundary in the trace: a map's boundaries do not change from
    scene to scene, so each is checked once however many scenes and calls read it. -/
def simpleTable (scenes : Array Scene) : List SimpleEntry :=
  scenes.foldl (fun acc s => s.structures.foldl (fun acc st =>
      match st.boundary with
      | none => acc
      | some b =>
        if acc.any (fun e => e.id == st.id && sameBoundary e.boundary b) then acc
        else ⟨st.id, b, Thunk.mk (fun _ => Geom.simplePolygon b), rfl⟩ :: acc) acc) []

/-- The trace indexed for evaluation, with the run's reading. `aggregateOverrides` fixes the
    membership of a track in an aggregate to a value, for the sensitivity of a verdict to that
    membership; it is empty in every evaluation that judges a trace. -/
structure Ctx where
  scenes : Array Scene
  times : Array Q
  ρ : Reading
  aggregateOverrides : List (TrackId × String × Bool) := []
  /-- The simple-polygon flags of the trace's boundaries (`simpleIn`). -/
  simple : List SimpleEntry := simpleTable scenes
  /-- What a region quantifier reads of these scenes, built once and shared by every evaluation of
      this context (`RegionTable`). -/
  regions : RegionTable.Tables scenes := RegionTable.Tables.build scenes

/-- Whether a region's boundary is a simple polygon, read from the trace's table when the region and
    its boundary are there, checked directly otherwise. -/
def simpleIn (c : Ctx) (r : RegionId) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  match c.simple.find? (fun e => e.id == r && sameBoundary e.boundary poly) with
  | some e => e.flag.get
  | none => Geom.simplePolygon poly

/-- The table never changes the answer: a hit is the direct check of the same boundary, a miss (a
    region or boundary not in the table, a boundary changed since) is the direct check. -/
theorem simpleIn_eq (c : Ctx) (r : RegionId) (poly : List Vec) : simpleIn c r poly = Geom.simplePolygon poly := by
  unfold simpleIn
  split
  · rename_i e h
    have hp := List.find?_some h
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at hp
    rw [e.ok, sameBoundary_eq hp.2]
  · rfl

def Ctx.mk' (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) : Ctx :=
  { scenes := τ.toArray, times := (τ.map fun s => Time.ofTimestamp s.t).toArray, ρ := ρ }
def Ctx.n (c : Ctx) : Nat := c.scenes.size

/-- An argument as the dispatcher receives it: a resolved entity id (tracks, regions and devices
    are all `Nat`), an enumeration spelling, or a natural. -/
inductive DArg
  | v (id : Nat)
  | s (lit : String)
  | n (nat : Nat)
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lifting scene functions over the trace; positions for windows
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def each (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → R) : Array R := c.scenes.map f
def eachQ (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → QR) : Array QR := c.scenes.map f
def timePos (c : Ctx) : Array (Option Q) := c.times.map some
def pathPos (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) : Array (Option Q) := c.scenes.map (kin_path_length · x)
def positions (c : Ctx) (m : Measure) (x : TrackId) : Array (Option Q) :=
  match m with | .time => timePos c | .path => pathPos c x
def missingPos (m : Measure) : UnknownReason :=
  match m with | .time => .outOfRange | .path => .absentAtom "kin_path_length"

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/-- Heading change (degrees, left positive) integrated over the back window of length w:
    prefix sums of yaw rate × interval, one window query per instant. -/
def yawChange (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (w : Q) : Array (Except UnknownReason Q) :=
  let n := c.n
  -- sums[i] = Σ_{k ≤ i} ω_k (t_k − t_{k−1}); a missing yaw rate contributes nothing and is tracked
  let sums := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Q) i =>
    let prev := if i = 0 then Q.zero else acc[i - 1]!
    let dt := if i = 0 then Q.zero else Q.sub c.times[i]! c.times[i - 1]!
    acc.push (match kin_yaw_rate c.scenes[i]! x with
      | some ω => Q.add prev (Q.mul ω dt)
      | none => prev)) #[]
  -- lastMissing[i] = latest index ≤ i with a missing yaw rate (n when none)
  let lastMissing := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    acc.push (if (kin_yaw_rate c.scenes[i]! x).isNone then i else (if i = 0 then n else acc[i - 1]!))) #[]
  let wins := Time.backWindows (timePos c) w
  (Array.range n).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => .error .outOfRange
    | some win =>

      else if !win.adequate then .error (.samplingGap "prim_heading_change")
      else

-- The primitives
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- minute m of the day lies in the window [start, end), wrapping past midnight when end ≤ start. -/

private def vecAtom (o : Option Vec) (name : String) : Except UnknownReason Vec :=

/-- Under constant velocities, the time of closest approach of the two centres and the centre
    distance then; `none` when the paths do not approach within `[0, horizon]`. -/
private def closestApproach (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Except UnknownReason (Option (Q × Q)) := do
  let pa ← vecAtom (kin_position s a) "kin_position"
  let pb ← vecAtom (kin_position s b) "kin_position"
  let va ← vecAtom (kin_velocity s a) "kin_velocity"
  let vb ← vecAtom (kin_velocity s b) "kin_velocity"

  let v := Geom.vsub vb va
  let vv := Geom.dot v v

  eachQ c fun s => do

    | some (t, _) => pure t
    | none => throw (.undefined "prim_closest_approach_time")

def prim_closest_approach_distance (c : Ctx) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Array QR :=
  eachQ c fun s => do
    match ← closestApproach s a b horizon with
    | some (_, dist) => pure dist
    | none => throw (.undefined "prim_closest_approach_distance")

def prim_conditions_hold (c : Ctx) (d : DeviceId) (x : TrackId) : Array R :=
  each c fun s =>
    let conds := match dev_zone_sign_conditions s d with
      | some cd => some cd

    R.bindOpt conds (.absentAtom "dev_zone_sign_conditions") fun cd =>

            let dayOk : R := match w.calendarClass with
              | some cls => R.ofOption (s.assumption cls) (.assumptionMissing cls)
              | none => R.ofBool (w.weekdays.isEmpty || w.weekdays.contains ct.weekday)
            R.and dayOk (R.ofBool (inWindow w ct.minuteOfDay)))
      let occOk : R := match cd.minOccupancy with
        | none => R.t
        | some n => bAtom ((ru_occupant_count s x).map (· ≥ n)) "ru_occupant_count"
      let clsOk : R := match cd.vehicleClass with
        | none => R.t
        | some k => bAtom (hasClassOpt s x k) "ru_class"
      let childOk : R :=
        if cd.whenChildrenPresent then R.any (s.tracks.map fun y => bAtom (ru_child s y) "ru_child") else R.t
      R.and (R.and timeOk occOk) (R.and clsOk childOk)

/-- The signed lateral offset of region r from road user x (m, left positive): the component,
    perpendicular to x's heading, of the vector from x's reference point to the nearest point of
    r's boundary; zero where the reference point lies inside r. Where several boundary points are
    equally nearest, their common component; undefined where those components differ. -/
def prim_region_lateral_offset (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (r : RegionId) : Array QR :=
  eachQ c fun s => do
    let some p := kin_position s x | throw (.absentAtom "kin_position")
    let some h := kin_heading s x | throw (.absentAtom "kin_heading")
    let some poly := st_region_geometry_boundary s r | throw (.absentAtom "st_region_geometry")
    if Geom.inPolygon p poly then pure Q.zero

/-

  s2  — the subject is a member of the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle (`ru_aggregate`).
  s3  — applicability: the subject occupies (`rel_occupies`) a `highway` h on which (`st_on_way`) a

        `zone_sign` of kind no_passing, not an end sign, governs (`dev_governs`), or it occupies a
        `lane` whose left `st_lane_marking` is solid or double_solid and yellow; a solid_broken left
        marking leaves that lane's membership unknown (`definedWhen`).
        obligation: for every highway h the subject occupies and every centre line c on it, the
        body does not reach past c to the left: 2·offset(c) ≥ width − 2·tolerance, i.e. the lateral
        offset of c (`prim_region_lateral_offset`, left positive) is not below half the width
        (`kin_extent` "width") minus `p.lateral_position_tolerance` (written doubled so that no
        literal 2 is needed). Judged at every observation ("throughout its length").
  s6/s10 — the excused act is that same crossing of c.

/-- s7 (E3): within the turn window the subject occupies a highway other than `h`, and not `h`. -/

  .within .time pVehicleTurnWindow "subject"

      (.and (occupies "h2") (.and (.not (.same (.var "h2") (.var h))) (.not (occupies h)))))

def leftTurnDeclared : Formula :=
  .or (.existsRegion (.lit "intersection") "t" (.intent "int.left_turn" vSubject (.var "t")))
      (.existsRegion (.lit "driveway_or_alley_entrance") "t" (.intent "int.left_turn" vSubject (.var "t")))

/-- s10–s14 (E4), less the signal and impediment conditions it shares with E3. -/
def leftTurnExcuse : Formula :=
  .and leftTurnDeclared (.and (.rule "NRS_484B_413_2" [("subject", "subject")]) safe)

/-- Applicability: the subject, on a highway with a centre line, within a no-passing zone. -/
def applicability : Formula :=
  .and (.existsRegion (.lit "highway") "h"
          (.and (occupies "h") (.existsRegion (.lit "centre_line") "c" (onWay "c" "h"))))
       inZone

/-- Obligation: for every highway occupied and centre line on it, no crossing unless excused
    (E3 to an adjoining highway, E4 to make a left-hand turn). -/

  .forallRegion (.lit "highway") "h"
    (.implies (occupies "h")
      (.forallRegion (.lit "centre_line") "c"
        (.implies (onWay "c" "h")
          (.or (.not (crossing "c"))
            (.and (signalledFirst "c")
              (.and noImpediment
                (.or (reachesAdjoiningHighway "h") leftTurnExcuse)))))))
